title.zh: 卷一百十九 志第七十二 禮二十二
title.raw: 卷一百十九 志第七十二 禮二十二 Volume 119 Treatises 72: Rites 22

sentences.zh: 禮二十二

translations.literal: Rites, Part Twenty-Two
translations.idiomatic: Rites 22

sentences.zh: （賓禮四）〉

translations.literal: (Guest Rites, Part Four)
translations.idiomatic: (Guest Rites IV)

sentences.zh: ○錄周後錄先聖後群臣朝使宴餞朝臣時節饋廩外國君長來朝契丹夏國使副見辭儀高麗附金國使副見辭儀諸國朝貢

translations.literal: ○ Recording the descendants of Zhou; recording the descendants of the prior sages; court audiences and envoys; banquets for seeing off envoys; seasonal gifts to court ministers; foreign rulers coming to court; protocols for audiences and farewells with envoys from Khitan and Western Xia; protocols for audiences and farewells with envoys from Goryeo attached to the Jin state; tribute missions from the various states
translations.idiomatic: ○ Records of the Zhou succession; records of the sage's line; rites for ministers at court and on mission; farewell banquets; seasonal provisions for officials; audiences with foreign rulers; Khitan and Xia envoy reception and farewell protocols; Goryeo and Jin-affiliated envoy protocols; tribute from the various states

sentences.zh: 昔周滅殷，封微子為殷後，俾修其禮物，作賓於王家，與國鹹休。

translations.literal: In antiquity, when Zhou destroyed Yin, it enfeoffed Weizi as heir of Yin, causing him to maintain its ritual objects, to serve as a guest of the royal house, and to share in the state's good fortune.
translations.idiomatic: When the Zhou overthrew the Yin, they enfeoffed Weizi as heir to the Yin line, charged him with preserving its ritual regalia, and received him at court as an honored guest so that he might share in the dynasty's prosperity.

sentences.zh: 宋以柴周之後為二恪，又錄孔子之後，亦先王崇德象賢之意也，故皆為賓禮。

translations.literal: Song took the descendants of Chai of Zhou as one of the two Ke, and also recorded the descendants of Confucius—this too was in the spirit of the former kings' honoring virtue and taking worthy men as models—therefore all were treated as guest rites.
translations.idiomatic: The Song honored the Chai line of the Later Zhou as one of the two Ke successors and likewise enrolled Confucius's descendants, in keeping with the ancient ideal of revering virtue and holding up worthy exemplars; all of these arrangements belong under guest rites.

sentences.zh: 其餘則有朝使之宴餞、歲時之廩饋及外國之使聘、遠方之朝貢，著其迓餞宴賚之式，登降揖遜之儀，備一代之製焉。

translations.literal: Beyond these there were banquets to see off envoys on court missions, seasonal granary gifts, embassies from foreign states, and tribute from distant regions, setting forth the forms for welcoming, seeing off, feasting, and bestowing gifts, and the protocols of ascending, descending, bowing, and yielding—thus completing the institutions of an age.
translations.idiomatic: The chapter also covers farewell feasts for departing envoys, seasonal grain gifts to officials, foreign embassies, and distant tribute missions, codifying how guests were received, entertained, and sent off, together with the full etiquette of movement and obeisance, so that the guest rites of the dynasty might be complete.

sentences.zh: 仁宗天聖六年，錄故虢州防禦使柴貴子肅為三班奉職。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Tiansheng under Emperor Renzong, the son Su of the former Defender of Guo Prefecture Chai Gui was enrolled as a Third Class Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: In 1028, Emperor Renzong enrolled Su, son of the late Defender of Guo Prefecture Chai Gui, as a Third Class Attendant.

sentences.zh: 七年，錄故太子少傅柴守禮孫詠為三班奉職。

translations.literal: In the seventh year, the grandson Yong of the former Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Chai Shouli was enrolled as a Third Class Attendant.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, Yong, grandson of the late Junior Tutor to the Heir Apparent Chai Shouli, received the same appointment.

sentences.zh: 其後，又錄柴氏之後曰熙、曰 愈、曰若拙、曰上善並為三班奉職，曰餘慶、曰織為州長史、助教，曰貽廓等十一人復其身，仍各賜錢一萬。

translations.literal: Thereafter, descendants of the Chai clan named Xi, Yu, Ruozhuo, and Shangshan were all enrolled as Third Class Attendants; Yuqing and Zhi were made prefectural senior recorder and assistant instructor; Yikuang and eleven others were restored to commoner status, and each was still granted ten thousand cash.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Xi, Yu, Ruozhuo, and Shangshan of the Chai line were enrolled as Third Class Attendants; Yuqing and Zhi were appointed prefectural senior recorder and assistant instructor; Yikuang and eleven others were restored to commoner standing, each receiving ten thousand cash besides.

sentences.zh: 又錄世宗曾孫揆、柔及貴曾孫日宣、守禮曾孫若訥皆為 三班奉職。

translations.literal: Also enrolled were Shizong's great-grandsons Kui and Rou, Gui's great-grandson Rixuan, and Shouli's great-grandson Ruone—all as Third Class Attendants.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong's great-grandsons Kui and Rou, Gui's great-grandson Rixuan, and Shouli's great-grandson Ruone were enrolled as Third Class Attendants as well.

sentences.zh: 嘉祐四年，著作郎何鬲言：“昔舜受堯、禹受舜之天下，而封丹朱、商均以為國賓。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jiayou, Composition Gentleman He Ge said: "In antiquity Shun received the realm from Yao, and Yu received it from Shun, yet Danzhu and Shangjun were enfeoffed as state guests.
translations.idiomatic: In 1059, Composition Gentleman He Ge memorialized: "When Shun received the realm from Yao and Yu from Shun, they still enfeoffed Danzhu and Shangjun as honored guests of the state.

sentences.zh: 周、漢以降，以及於唐，莫不崇奉先代，延及苗裔。

translations.literal: From Zhou and Han down through Tang, none failed to honor former dynasties and extend favor to their descendants.
translations.idiomatic: From the Zhou and Han through the Tang, every dynasty honored its predecessors and extended that regard to their surviving lines.

sentences.zh: 本 朝受周天下，而近代之盛莫如唐，自梁以下，皆不足以崇襲。

translations.literal: Our dynasty received the realm from Zhou, yet among recent ages none was so great as Tang; from Liang downward, none suffices to be honored in succession.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty received the mandate from the Later Zhou, yet among recent dynasties none rivaled the Tang; from the Liang onward, none merits comparable honor.

sentences.zh: 臣願考求唐、周之裔，以備二王之後，授以爵命，封縣立廟，世世承襲，永為國賓。

translations.literal: Your servant wishes to investigate and seek out the descendants of Tang and Zhou to supply the successors of the two kings, grant them titles and offices, enfeoff counties and establish temples, have them inherit generation after generation, and make them state guests forever.
translations.idiomatic: I propose that we search out the lines of Tang and Zhou, appoint successors to the two honored royal houses, grant titles and offices, assign counties and establish temples, and let the lines inherit in perpetuity as permanent guests of the state.

sentences.zh: ”事下太常議， 曰：“古者立二王後，不惟繼絕，兼取其明德可法。

translations.literal: " The matter was referred to the Directorate of Ceremonies for deliberation, which said: "In antiquity, when establishing the successors of the two kings, it was not only to continue a broken line but also to take their bright virtue as something to be emulated.
translations.idiomatic: " The memorial was referred to the Directorate of Ceremonies, which replied: "The ancient institution of the two royal successors served not only to continue a broken line but to hold up their bright virtue as a model.

sentences.zh: 五代草創，載祀不永，文章制度，一無可考。

translations.literal: The Five Dynasties were hastily founded, their sacrifices did not long endure, and their writings and institutions offer nothing worth examining.
translations.idiomatic: The Five Dynasties were ephemeral foundations whose rites scarcely endured and whose institutions offer nothing worth emulating.

sentences.zh: 上取唐室，世數已遠，於經不合。

translations.literal: To take the house of Tang would place the generations too far back and would not accord with the classics.
translations.idiomatic: Elevating the Tang would place the succession too many generations removed and would not accord with classical precedent.

sentences.zh: 惟周則我受禪之所自，義不可 廢。

translations.literal: Only Zhou is the source from which we received the abdication; on principle it cannot be abandoned.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Zhou is the dynasty from which we received the abdicated throne; on principle its line cannot be set aside.

sentences.zh: 宜訪求子孫，如孔子後衍聖公，授一京官，爵以公號，使專奉廟饗，歲時存問，賜之粟帛、牲器、祭服。

translations.literal: Descendants should be sought out; as with the Duke Who Extends Sageliness among Confucius's descendants, grant a capital office, bestow a ducal title, charge them solely with maintaining temple offerings, send seasonal inquiries, and grant grain, silk, sacrificial animals, vessels, and sacrificial robes.
translations.idiomatic: We should seek out Zhou descendants and, following the precedent of the Duke Who Extends Sageliness in Confucius's line, appoint one to a capital office with a ducal title, charge him solely with maintaining the ancestral temple, send seasonal inquiries, and supply grain, silk, sacrificial animals, vessels, and vestments.

sentences.zh: 每遇時祀，並從官給，其廟宇亦加嚴飾。

translations.literal: Whenever seasonal sacrifices occur, all supplies shall be provided by the state; the temple buildings shall also receive solemn adornment.
translations.idiomatic: At each seasonal sacrifice the state should furnish all requirements, and the temple buildings should receive dignified upkeep.

sentences.zh: 如此，則上不 失繼絕之義，度之於今，亦簡而易行。

translations.literal: In this way, above one would not fail the principle of continuing a broken line; measured against the present, it is also simple and easy to carry out.
translations.idiomatic: Thus the court would not fail in the duty to continue a broken line, and measured against present circumstances the arrangement would be simple and practicable.

sentences.zh: ”從之。

translations.literal: " The proposal was adopted.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved the proposal.

sentences.zh: 四月，詔曰：“先王推紹天之序，尚尊賢之義，褒其後嗣，賓以殊禮，豈非聖人稽古報功之大典哉？

translations.literal: In the fourth month, an edict said: "The former kings extended Heaven's order, esteemed the principle of honoring the worthy, praised their descendants, and received them as guests with special rites—is this not the great canon by which sages examine antiquity and repay merit?
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month an edict declared: "The former kings upheld Heaven's order, honored the worthy, rewarded their descendants, and received them with exceptional guest rites—is this not the great canon by which the sages looked to antiquity and repaid merit?

sentences.zh: 國家受命之元， 繼周而王，雖民靈欣戴，曆數允集，而虞賓將遜，德美丕顯。

translations.literal: At the founding of our state's reception of the mandate, succeeding Zhou as king, though the people's spirits rejoiced in support and the calendar's numbers truly gathered, yet the guest of Yu was about to yield, and his virtue and beauty were greatly displayed.
translations.idiomatic: When our dynasty first received the mandate, succeeding the Zhou as sovereign, the people rejoiced and the times aligned, yet the honored guest of Yu was yielding the throne, and his virtue shone all the more brightly.

sentences.zh: 頃者推命本始，褒及支庶，每遇南郊，許奏白身一名充班行，恩則厚矣，而義未稱。

translations.literal: Recently, tracing the mandate to its origin, favor was extended to collateral lines; at each Southern Suburban Sacrifice one commoner without office was permitted to be presented to fill a court rank—the grace was already generous, yet the principle was not yet fitting.
translations.idiomatic: Recently, in tracing the mandate to its source, favor was extended to collateral lines of the Zhou house; at each Southern Suburban Sacrifice one commoner was permitted to enter court service—the kindness was generous, yet it did not fully meet the proper standard.

sentences.zh: 將上采姚、姒之 舊，略循周、漢之典，詳其世嫡，優以公爵，異其仕進之路，申以土田之錫，俾廟寢有奉，饗祀不輟，庶幾乎《春秋》通三統、厚先代之製矣。

translations.literal: We shall take as our model above the precedent of Yao and Si, follow in outline the institutions of Zhou and Han, examine their direct line of succession, favor them with a ducal title, set apart their path of advancement, extend grants of land and fields, cause the temple chambers to have support, and sacrifices to continue without interruption—perhaps thus approaching the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》' connecting the three successions and honoring the institutions of former ages.
translations.idiomatic: We shall look to the ancient precedents of Yao and Si, follow in outline the Zhou and Han institutions, identify the direct heir, bestow a ducal title, set apart his path of advancement, grant lands and fields, ensure that the ancestral temple has support and sacrifices continue without interruption, and thereby approach the 《Spring and Autumn Annals》 ideal of linking the three successions and honoring former dynasties.

sentences.zh: 宜令有司取柴氏譜 係，於諸房中推最長一人，令歲時親奉周室祀事。

translations.literal: The relevant offices should take the Chai clan genealogy and, among the various branches, select the eldest person, charging him each year personally to perform the sacrifices of the Zhou house.
translations.idiomatic: Let the relevant offices obtain the Chai genealogy, select the eldest member among the branches, and charge him each year to perform the Zhou ancestral sacrifices in person.

sentences.zh: 如白身，即與京主簿，如為班行者，即比類換文資，仍封崇義公，與河南府、鄭州合入差遣，給公田十頃，專管勾 陵廟。

translations.literal: If a commoner without office, grant the post of Capital Registrar; if already serving in the court ranks, convert by analogy to a civil appointment; still enfeoff as Duke of Chongyi, assign jointly with Henan Prefecture and Zheng Prefecture, grant ten qing of ducal fields, and charge him solely with overseeing the imperial tombs and temples.
translations.idiomatic: If he holds no office, appoint him Capital Registrar; if he already serves in the court ranks, convert his appointment to a civil post; enfeoff him as Duke of Chongyi; assign him jointly with Henan and Zheng prefectures; grant ten qing of ducal land; and charge him solely with overseeing the Zhou imperial tombs and temples.

sentences.zh: 應緣祭饗禮料所須，皆從官給。

translations.literal: All materials required for sacrificial offerings shall be supplied by the state.
translations.idiomatic: All materials required for sacrificial offerings shall be furnished by the state.

sentences.zh: 如至知州資序，即別與差遣，卻取以次近親，令襲爵授官，永為定式。

translations.literal: If he reaches the qualification sequence of prefect, assign another post, then take the next nearest collateral relative and have him inherit the title and receive office—this shall be the permanent rule.
translations.idiomatic: When the incumbent reaches prefectural rank, assign him another post and have the next nearest collateral relative inherit the title and office, establishing this as the permanent rule.

sentences.zh: ”八月，太常禮院定到內殿崇班、相州兵馬都監柴詠於 柴氏諸族最長，詔換殿中丞，封崇義公，簽書奉寧軍節度判官事，以奉周祀。

translations.literal: " In the eighth month, the Directorate of Ceremonies and the Rites Court determined that Inner Hall Honored Companion and Xiang Prefecture Military Commissioner Chai Yong was the eldest among the Chai clans; an edict converted his post to Palace Vice Director, enfeoffed him as Duke of Chongyi, and assigned him to sign as military commissioner of Fengning Circuit to perform the Zhou sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: " In the eighth month the Directorate of Ceremonies identified Inner Hall Honored Companion and Xiang Prefecture Military Commissioner Chai Yong as the eldest of the Chai line; the court promoted him to Palace Vice Director, enfeoffed him as Duke of Chongyi, and assigned him to sign as military commissioner of Fengning Circuit to maintain the Zhou sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 又以六廟在西京，而歲時祭饗無器服之數，令有司以三品服一、四品服二及所當用祭器 給之。

translations.literal: Moreover, because the six temples were in the Western Capital and the seasonal sacrifices lacked prescribed numbers of vessels and robes, the relevant offices were ordered to supply one third-rank robe, two fourth-rank robes, and the requisite sacrificial vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Because the six ancestral temples stood in the Western Capital and the seasonal sacrifices lacked prescribed vestments and vessels, the relevant offices were ordered to supply one third-rank robe, two fourth-rank robes, and the requisite sacrificial implements.

sentences.zh: 熙寧四年，西京留司御史台司馬光言：“崇義公柴詠祭祀不以儀式。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Xining, Western Capital Remaining Office Censorate Commissioner Sima Guang said: "Duke of Chongyi Chai Yong does not perform sacrifices according to ritual forms.
translations.idiomatic: In 1071, Western Capital Remaining Office Censorate Commissioner Sima Guang memorialized: "Duke of Chongyi Chai Yong does not conduct the sacrifices according to proper ritual form.

sentences.zh: 周本郭姓，世宗後侄，為郭氏後。

translations.literal: Zhou was originally of the Guo surname; Shizong adopted a nephew as heir and made him successor to the Guo line.
translations.idiomatic: The Later Zhou were originally of the Guo surname; Shizong adopted a nephew as heir, making him successor to the Guo line.

sentences.zh: 今存周後，則宜封郭氏子孫以奉周祀。

translations.literal: Now that the Zhou succession is preserved, the descendants of the Guo clan ought to be enfeoffed to perform the Zhou sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: If we are to preserve the Zhou succession, we ought to enfeoff descendants of the Guo line to maintain the Zhou sacrifices.

sentences.zh: ” 帝閱奏，問王安石，安石曰：“宋受天下於世宗，柴氏也。

translations.literal: " The emperor read the memorial and asked Wang Anshi; Anshi said: "Song received the realm from Shizong, and that was the Chai clan.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor read the memorial and consulted Wang Anshi, who replied: "The Song received the realm from Shizong of the Chai line.

sentences.zh: ”帝曰：“為人後者為之子。

translations.literal: " The emperor said: "One who becomes another's heir is considered that person's son.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor said: "One who becomes another's heir is reckoned as that person's son.

sentences.zh: ”安石曰：“為人後於異姓，非禮也。

translations.literal: " Anshi said: "To become another's heir to a different surname is not according to ritual.
translations.idiomatic: " Anshi replied: "Becoming heir to a different surname is not proper ritual.

sentences.zh: 雖受天下於郭氏，豈可以天下之故而 易其姓氏所出？

translations.literal: Even though the realm was received from the Guo clan, how can one because of possessing the realm change the surname from which one sprang?
translations.idiomatic: Even though the realm was received from the Guo line, can possession of the empire alter the surname from which one sprang?

sentences.zh: ”帝然之。

translations.literal: " The emperor agreed.
translations.idiomatic: " The emperor accepted this view.

sentences.zh: 五年正月，柴詠致仕。

translations.literal: In the first month of the fifth year, Chai Yong retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of 1072, Chai Yong retired from office.

sentences.zh: 詠長子早亡，嫡孫夷簡當襲。

translations.literal: Yong's eldest son had died early; the legitimate grandson Yijian ought to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: Yong's eldest son had died young; his legitimate grandson Yijian was the proper heir.

sentences.zh: 太常禮院言夷簡有過，合以次子西頭供奉官若訥承襲。

translations.literal: The Directorate of Ceremonies and Rites Court said Yijian had offenses and that the second son, Western Head Attendant Ruone, ought to inherit.
translations.idiomatic: The Directorate of Ceremonies reported that Yijian had committed offenses and that the second son, Western Head Attendant Ruone, ought to inherit instead.

sentences.zh: 詔以若訥為衛尉寺丞，襲封崇 義公，簽書河南府判官廳公事。

translations.literal: An edict appointed Ruone as Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, to inherit enfeoffment as Duke of Chongyi, and to sign as recorder of the Henan Prefecture judicial commissioner's office.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed Ruone Vice Director of the Court of Imperial Entertainments, enfeoffed him as Duke of Chongyi, and assigned him to sign as recorder of the Henan Prefecture judicial commissioner's office.

sentences.zh: 政和八年，徽宗詔曰：“昔我藝祖受禪於周，嘉祐中擇柴氏旁支一名封崇義公。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Zhenghe, Emperor Huizong's edict said: "In antiquity our dynastic founder received the abdication from Zhou; in Jiayou a collateral branch of the Chai clan was selected and enfeoffed as Duke of Chongyi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1118, Emperor Huizong decreed: "Our dynastic founder received the abdication from the Later Zhou; during the Jiayou era a collateral branch of the Chai line was selected and enfeoffed as Duke of Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 議者謂不當封周。

translations.literal: Critics said Zhou ought not to have been enfeoffed.
translations.idiomatic: Critics argued that the Zhou line ought not to have been enfeoffed.

sentences.zh: 然禪國者周，而三恪 之封不及，禮蓋未盡。

translations.literal: Yet the state that yielded the throne was Zhou, and the enfeoffment of the three Ke did not reach it—the rites were perhaps not yet complete.
translations.idiomatic: Yet it was the Zhou who yielded the throne, and the honor of the three Ke did not extend to them—the rites were not yet complete.

sentences.zh: 除崇義公依舊外，擇柴氏最長見在者以其祖父為周恭帝後，以其孫世世為宣義郎，監周陵廟，與知縣請給，以示繼絕之仁，為國二恪，永為定 製。

translations.literal: Apart from leaving the Duke of Chongyi as before, select the eldest living member of the Chai clan whose grandfather was heir to Zhou Gongdi, and have his descendants generation after generation serve as Gentleman of Propagating Righteousness, supervising the Zhou imperial tombs and temples, with stipends equal to a prefect—thus displaying the benevolence of continuing a broken line, making them the state's two Ke, forever as a fixed institution.
translations.idiomatic: Apart from maintaining the Duke of Chongyi as before, select the eldest living Chai descendant whose grandfather was heir to Emperor Gong of Zhou, and let his descendants generation after generation serve as Gentleman of Propagating Righteousness, supervising the Zhou imperial tombs and temples with stipends equal to a prefect's—thus displaying the benevolence of continuing a broken line as one of the state's two Ke, permanently established.

sentences.zh: 紹興五年，詔周世宗玄孫柴叔夏為右承奉郎，襲封崇義公，奉周後。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shaoxing, an edict appointed Shizong's great-great-grandson Chai Shuxia as Right Attendant for Presentation, to inherit enfeoffment as Duke of Chongyi and maintain the Zhou succession.
translations.idiomatic: In 1135, an edict appointed Shizong's great-great-grandson Chai Shuxia Right Attendant for Presentation, enfeoffed him as Duke of Chongyi, and charged him with maintaining the Zhou succession.

sentences.zh: 二十六年，叔夏升知州資序，別與差遣。

translations.literal: In the twenty-sixth year, Shuxia rose to the qualification sequence of prefect and received a separate assignment.
translations.idiomatic: In 1156, Shuxia rose to prefectural rank and received a separate assignment.

sentences.zh: 以子國器襲封，令居衢州。

translations.literal: His son Guoqi inherited the enfeoffment and was ordered to reside in Qu Prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guoqi inherited the title and was ordered to reside in Qu Prefecture.

sentences.zh: 朝廷有大禮，則入侍祠如故事。

translations.literal: When the court held great ceremonies, he entered to attend sacrifices according to precedent.
translations.idiomatic: When the court held major ceremonies, he came to court to perform the sacrifices according to precedent.

sentences.zh: 其柴大有、柴安宅亦各補官。

translations.literal: Chai Dayou and Chai Anzhai were also each granted offices.
translations.idiomatic: Chai Dayou and Chai Anzhai were also granted offices.

sentences.zh: 淳祐九年，又以世宗八世孫柴彥穎特補承務郎，襲封崇義公。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Chunyou, Shizong's eighth-generation descendant Chai Yanying was specially appointed Attendant for Affairs and inherited enfeoffment as Duke of Chongyi.
translations.idiomatic: In 1249, Shizong's eighth-generation descendant Chai Yanying was specially appointed Attendant for Affairs and inherited the title of Duke of Chongyi.

sentences.zh: 時又求隋、唐及朱氏、李氏、石氏、劉氏、郭氏之後，及吳越、荊南、湖南、蜀漢諸國之子孫，皆命以官，使守其祀。

translations.literal: At that time, descendants of Sui, Tang, and the Zhu, Li, Shi, Liu, and Guo clans were also sought, as well as descendants of the states of Wuyue, Jingnan, Hunan, and Shuhan—all were ordered to offices to maintain their sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At that time the court also sought descendants of the Sui and Tang, and of the Zhu, Li, Shi, Liu, and Guo houses, together with descendants of Wuyue, Jingnan, Hunan, and Shuhan, appointing them to office to maintain their ancestral sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 具見《本紀》、《世家》。

translations.literal: Details are fully set forth in the 《Basic Annals》 and 《Hereditary Houses》.
translations.idiomatic: Full details appear in the 《Basic Annals》 and 《Hereditary Houses》.

sentences.zh: 錄先聖後，仁宗景祐二年，詔以孔子四十六世孫北海尉宗願為國子監主簿，襲封文宣公。

translations.literal: Recording the descendants of the prior sage: In the second year of Jingyou under Emperor Renzong, an edict appointed Confucius's forty-sixth-generation descendant Zongyuan, magistrate of Beihai, as Registrar of the Directorate of Education and to inherit enfeoffment as Duke of Literary Propagation.
translations.idiomatic: Recording the sage's line: In 1035, Emperor Renzong appointed Confucius's forty-sixth-generation descendant Zongyuan, magistrate of Beihai, Registrar of the Directorate of Education and Duke of Literary Propagation.

sentences.zh: 皇祐三年七月，詔曰：“國朝以來，世以孔氏子孫知仙源縣，使奉承廟祀。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year of Huangyou, an edict said: "Since the founding of our dynasty, generation after generation a descendant of the Kong clan has governed Xianyuan County to attend to the temple sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of 1051 an edict declared: "Since the founding of our dynasty, a Kong descendant has generation after generation governed Xianyuan County to maintain the temple sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 近歲廢而不行，非所以尊先聖也。

translations.literal: In recent years this has been abandoned and not carried out—this is not the way to honor the prior sage.
translations.idiomatic: In recent years this practice has lapsed, which is not the way to honor the sage.

sentences.zh: 宜以孔氏子孫知仙源縣事。

translations.literal: A descendant of the Kong clan should govern the affairs of Xianyuan County.
translations.idiomatic: A Kong descendant should again govern Xianyuan County.

sentences.zh: 至和初，太常博士祖無擇言：“按前史，孔子後襲封者，在漢、魏曰褒成、褒尊、宗聖，在晉、宋曰奉聖，後魏曰崇聖，北齊曰恭聖，後周、隋並封鄒國，唐初曰褒聖，開元中，始追諡孔子為文宣王。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhihe, Erudite of the Directorate of Ceremonies Zu Wuzhe said: "According to earlier histories, those who inherited enfeoffment among Confucius's descendants were called Lord Who Extols Completion and Lord Who Extols Honor in Han and Wei, Lord Who Upholds Sageliness in Jin and Song, Lord Who Honors Sageliness in Later Wei, Lord Who Reveres Sageliness in Northern Qi; Later Zhou and Sui both enfeoffed the state of Zou; in early Tang they were called Lord Who Extols Sageliness; in the Kaiyuan era Confucius was first posthumously titled King of Literary Propagation.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhihe era, Erudite of the Directorate of Ceremonies Zu Wuzhe memorialized: "Earlier histories show that Confucius's heirs bore different enfeoffment titles in each age—Lord Who Extols Completion and Lord Who Extols Honor in Han and Wei, Lord Who Upholds Sageliness in Jin and Song, Lord Who Honors Sageliness in Later Wei, Lord Who Reveres Sageliness in Northern Qi; Later Zhou and Sui enfeoffed the state of Zou; early Tang used Lord Who Extols Sageliness; and in the Kaiyuan era Confucius was first posthumously titled King of Literary Propagation.

sentences.zh: 又以其後為文宣公，不可以祖諡而加後嗣。

translations.literal: Moreover, his descendants were made Dukes of Literary Propagation—one cannot apply the ancestor's posthumous title to later heirs.
translations.idiomatic: His descendants were titled Duke of Literary Propagation, yet one cannot apply the ancestor's posthumous title to later heirs.

sentences.zh: ”遂詔有司定封宗願衍聖公，令世襲焉。

translations.literal: " Thereupon an edict ordered the relevant offices to fix Zongyuan's enfeoffment as Duke Who Extends Sageliness, to be inherited generation after generation.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then ordered that Zongyuan be enfeoffed as Duke Who Extends Sageliness, the title to pass in perpetuity.

sentences.zh: 治平初，用京東提點王綱言，自今勿以孔氏子弟知仙源縣，其襲封人如無親屬在鄉里，令常任近便官，不得去家廟。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Zhiping, adopting the proposal of Eastern Capital Circuit Intendant Wang Gang, from now on Kong clan descendants were no longer to govern Xianyuan County; if the inheritor of the enfeoffment had no relatives in the home district, he was to hold a nearby convenient office permanently and might not leave the family temple.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Zhiping era, adopting Eastern Capital Circuit Intendant Wang Gang's proposal, Kong descendants were no longer to govern Xianyuan County; if the title-holder had no relatives in the home district, he was to hold a nearby office permanently and might not leave the family temple.

sentences.zh: 熙寧中，以四十八代孫若蒙為沂州新泰縣主簿，襲封。

translations.literal: During Xining, the forty-eighth-generation descendant Ruomeng was made Registrar of Xintai County in Yi Prefecture and inherited the enfeoffment.
translations.idiomatic: During the Xining era, the forty-eighth-generation descendant Ruomeng was appointed Registrar of Xintai County in Yi Prefecture and inherited the title.

sentences.zh: 元祐初，朝議大夫孔宗翰辭司農少卿，請依家世例知兗州以奉祀。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Yuanyou, Court Gentleman for Discussion Kong Zonghan resigned as Vice Minister of the Directorate of Agriculture and requested, according to the family precedent, to govern Yan Prefecture to perform the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of the Yuanyou era, Court Gentleman for Discussion Kong Zonghan resigned as Vice Minister of the Directorate of Agriculture and requested, following family precedent, to govern Yan Prefecture and maintain the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 又言：“孔子後襲封疏爵，本為侍祠，今乃兼領他官，不在故郡。

translations.literal: He also said: "Confucius's descendants who inherit enfeoffment hold a minor noble title originally for attending sacrifices, yet now they also hold other offices and are not in their former commandery.
translations.idiomatic: He added: "Confucius's heirs inherit a minor noble title originally intended for maintaining the sacrifices, yet they now hold other offices and are absent from their home commandery.

sentences.zh: 請自今襲封者無兼他職，終身 使在鄉里。

translations.literal: From now on, let those who inherit the enfeoffment hold no other offices and spend their lives in the home district.
translations.idiomatic: Henceforth let title-holders hold no other offices and remain in their home district for life.

sentences.zh: ”朝議依所請，命官以司其用度，立學以訓其子孫，襲封者專主祠事，增賜田百頃，供祭祀之餘許均贍族人。

translations.literal: " The court deliberation adopted his request: offices were appointed to manage expenditures, a school was established to instruct descendants, the inheritor of the enfeoffment was charged solely with temple affairs, an additional grant of one hundred qing of fields was made, and after supplying sacrifices the remainder was permitted to be distributed equally among clan members.
translations.idiomatic: " The court approved his request, appointed officials to manage expenditures, established a school to instruct descendants, charged the title-holder solely with temple affairs, granted an additional hundred qing of land, and permitted any surplus after sacrifices to be shared among clan members.

sentences.zh: 其差墓戶並如舊法。

translations.literal: The assignment of tomb households followed the old regulations as well.
translations.idiomatic: The assignment of tomb households followed the old regulations as well.

sentences.zh: 賜書，置教授一員，教 諭其家子弟，鄉鄰或願學者聽。

translations.literal: Books were granted, one instructor was established to teach and instruct the family's young men, and neighbors who wished to study were also permitted.
translations.idiomatic: Books were granted, an instructor was appointed to teach the family's young men, and neighbors who wished to study were also welcome.

sentences.zh: 改衍聖公為奉聖公，及刪定家祭冕服等制度頒賜之。

translations.literal: Duke Who Extends Sageliness was changed to Duke Who Upholds Sageliness, and the regulations for family sacrifices, coronets, robes, and the like were revised and bestowed.
translations.idiomatic: The title Duke Who Extends Sageliness was changed to Duke Who Upholds Sageliness, and revised regulations for family sacrifices, coronets, and robes were issued.

sentences.zh: 其後，通直郎孔宗壽等舉若蒙弟若虛襲封，仍請自今眾議擇承襲之人，不必子 繼，庶幾留意祖廟，惇睦族人。

translations.literal: Thereafter, Gentlemen for Direct Remonstrance Kong Zongshou and others recommended Ruomeng's younger brother Ruoxu to inherit the enfeoffment, and further requested that from now on the successor be chosen by collective deliberation, not necessarily by son succeeding father, so that attention might be paid to the ancestral temple and clan members treated with cordial solidarity.
translations.idiomatic: Later, Gentlemen for Direct Remonstrance Kong Zongshou and others recommended Ruomeng's younger brother Ruoxu to inherit the title and asked that henceforth the successor be chosen by collective deliberation rather than strict father-to-son succession, so that attention might remain on the ancestral temple and clan solidarity be preserved.

sentences.zh: 宣和三年，詔宣議郎孔端友襲封衍聖公，為通直郎、直秘閣，仍許就任關升，以示崇獎。

translations.literal: In the third year of Xuanhe, an edict had Gentleman of Propagating Righteousness Kong Duanyou inherit enfeoffment as Duke Who Extends Sageliness, appointed him Gentlemen for Direct Remonstrance and Direct Attendant of the Secret Archive, and still permitted advancement upon taking office to display honor and reward.
translations.idiomatic: In 1121, an edict had Gentleman of Propagating Righteousness Kong Duanyou inherit the title Duke Who Extends Sageliness, appointed him Gentlemen for Direct Remonstrance and Direct Attendant of the Secret Archive, and permitted advancement upon taking office as a mark of honor.

sentences.zh: 端友言：詔敕文宣王後與親屬一人判司簿尉，今孔若采當承繼推恩。

translations.literal: Duanyou said: "Edicts and commands grant one relative of the King of Literary Propagation a post as recorder or assistant magistrate; now Kong Ruocai ought to inherit this extended favor.
translations.idiomatic: Duanyou reported that edicts granted one relative of the King of Literary Propagation a post as recorder or assistant magistrate, and that Kong Ruocai was the proper heir to that favor.

sentences.zh: 詔補迪功郎。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.
translations.idiomatic: An edict appointed him Gentleman for Meritorious Achievement.

sentences.zh: 高宗紹興二年，以四十九代孫孔玠襲封衍聖公。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing under Emperor Gaozong, the forty-ninth-generation descendant Kong Jie inherited enfeoffment as Duke Who Extends Sageliness.
translations.idiomatic: In 1132, Emperor Gaozong had the forty-ninth-generation descendant Kong Jie inherit the title Duke Who Extends Sageliness.

sentences.zh: 其後，以搢、以文遠、以萬春、以洙，終宋世，皆襲封主祀事。

translations.literal: Thereafter Jin, Wenyuan, Wanchun, and Zhu inherited in turn; through the end of the Song, all inherited the enfeoffment and presided over the sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Jin, Wenyuan, Wanchun, and Zhu inherited in succession; through the end of the Song dynasty, each inherited the title and presided over the sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 群臣朝覲出使宴餞之儀。

translations.literal: The protocols for court ministers' audiences, missions abroad, and farewell banquets.
translations.idiomatic: Rites for court ministers at audience, on foreign mission, and at farewell banquets.

sentences.zh: 太祖、太宗朝，藩鎮牧伯，沿五代舊制，入覲及被召、使回，客省齎簽賜酒食。

translations.literal: In the reigns of Taizu and Taizong, frontier military governors followed the old Five Dynasties institutions: when coming to audience, being summoned, or returning from mission, the Guest Reception Office delivered signed orders bestowing wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizu and Taizong, military governors followed Five Dynasties precedent: on arriving for audience, being summoned to court, or returning from mission, the Guest Reception Office delivered signed orders granting wine and food.

sentences.zh: 節度使十日，留後七日，觀察使五日。

translations.literal: Military commissioners received provisions for ten days, acting commissioners for seven days, and observation commissioners for five days.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners received provisions for ten days, acting commissioners for seven, and observation commissioners for five.

sentences.zh: 代還，節度使五 日，留後三日，觀察一日，防禦使、團練使、刺史並賜生料。

translations.literal: On returning after replacement, military commissioners received five days, acting commissioners three days, observation commissioners one day; defenders, training commissioners, and prefects were all granted raw provisions.
translations.idiomatic: On returning after replacement, military commissioners received five days' provisions, acting commissioners three, observation commissioners one; defenders, training commissioners, and prefects all received raw provisions.

sentences.zh: 節度使以私故到闕下，及步軍都虞候以上出使回者，亦賜酒食、熟羊。

translations.literal: Military commissioners who came to the capital for private reasons, and those from Chief Commandant of the Foot Army and above returning from missions, also received wine, food, and cooked mutton.
translations.idiomatic: Military commissioners who came to the capital on private business, and officers from Chief Commandant of the Foot Army upward returning from mission, also received wine, food, and cooked mutton.

sentences.zh: 群臣出使回朝，見日，麵賜酒 食，中書、樞密、宣徽使、使相並樞密使伴；

translations.literal: When court ministers returned from missions and had their audience day, they were granted wine and food in person; Grand Councilors, Privy Councilors, Palace Service Commissioners, commissioners with diplomatic status, and Privy Councilors all served as companions;
translations.idiomatic: When ministers returned from mission and had their audience day, they received wine and food in person; Grand Councilors, Privy Councilors, Palace Service Commissioners, commissioners with diplomatic status, and Privy Councilors served as companions;

sentences.zh: 三司使、學士、東宮三師、仆射、御史大夫、節度使並宣徽使伴。

translations.literal: Directors of the Three Departments, academicians, the Heir Apparent's three preceptors, vice premiers, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioners were all accompanied by Palace Service Commissioners.
translations.idiomatic: Directors of the Three Departments, academicians, the Heir Apparent's three preceptors, vice premiers, Censor-in-Chief, and military commissioners were accompanied by Palace Service Commissioners.

sentences.zh: 兩省五品以上、侍御史、中丞、三司副使、東宮三 少、尚書丞郎、卿監、上將軍、留後、觀察防禦團練使、刺史、宣慶宣政昭宣使並客省使伴；

translations.literal: Fifth rank and above in the two departments, Attending Censor, Vice Censor-in-Chief, Vice Directors of the Three Departments, the Heir Apparent's three junior preceptors, Directors and Vice Directors in the Ministry of Personnel, Directors and Supervisors, Senior Generals, acting commissioners, observation/defense/training commissioners, prefects, and Xuanqing/Xuanzheng/Zhaoxuan Commissioners were all accompanied by Guest Reception Commissioners;
translations.idiomatic: Fifth rank and above in the two departments, Attending Censor, Vice Censor-in-Chief, Vice Directors of the Three Departments, the Heir Apparent's three junior preceptors, ministry directors and vice directors, directors and supervisors, senior generals, acting commissioners, observation/defense/training commissioners, prefects, and Xuanqing/Xuanzheng/Zhaoxuan Commissioners were accompanied by Guest Reception Commissioners;

sentences.zh: 少卿監、大將軍、諸司使以下任發運轉運提點刑獄、知軍州、通判、都 監、巡檢回者即賜，並通事舍人伴；

translations.literal: Junior Directors and Supervisors, Major Generals, and those below various commissioners who served as transport/intendant/criminal investigation commissioners, military prefects, judicial commissioners, garrison commanders, or patrol inspectors received gifts immediately upon return, accompanied by Protocol Officers;
translations.idiomatic: Junior directors and supervisors, major generals, and officials below various commissioners who served as transport, circuit intendant, criminal investigation, military prefect, judicial commissioner, garrison commander, or patrol inspector received gifts immediately upon return, accompanied by Protocol Officers;

sentences.zh: 客省、引進、四方館、閣門使並本廳就食。

translations.literal: Guest Reception, Introduction, Four Directions Hall, and Gate Commissioners all dined in their own offices.
translations.idiomatic: Guest Reception, Introduction, Four Directions Hall, and Gate Commissioners dined in their own offices.

sentences.zh: 群臣賀，賜衣；

translations.literal: When court ministers offered congratulations, robes were granted;
translations.idiomatic: When ministers offered congratulations, robes were granted;

sentences.zh: 奉慰，並特賜茶酒，或賜食外任遣人進奉，亦賜酒食，或生料。

translations.literal: when offering condolences of support, tea and wine were specially granted; or when granting food, if those in external posts sent persons to present tribute, wine and food or raw provisions were also granted.
translations.idiomatic: when offering condolences, tea and wine were specially granted; officials in external posts who sent envoys with tribute also received wine and food or raw provisions.

sentences.zh: 自十 月一日後盡正月，每五日起居，百官皆賜茶酒，諸軍分校三日一賜。

translations.literal: From the first day of the tenth month through the first month, at every fifth-day court session all officials were granted tea and wine; the various armies by branch received grants every three days.
translations.idiomatic: From the first day of the tenth month through the first month, at every fifth-day court session all officials received tea and wine; the various armies received grants every three days by branch.

sentences.zh: 冬至、二社、重陽、寒食，樞密近臣、禁軍大校或賜宴其第及府署中，率以為常。

translations.literal: At Winter Solstice, the two communal sacrifices, Double Ninth, and Cold Food Festival, privy councilors and senior officers of the forbidden armies were sometimes granted banquets at their residences and offices—this generally became customary.
translations.idiomatic: At Winter Solstice, the two communal sacrifices, Double Ninth, and Cold Food Festival, privy councilors and senior forbidden-army officers were often granted banquets at their residences and offices, which became customary.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年，詔自今兩省五品、尚書省四品、諸司三品以上官，同列出使，並許醵錢餞飲，仍休假一日。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, an edict declared that from now on officials of fifth rank and above in the two departments, fourth rank and above in the Ministry of Personnel, and third rank and above in the various commissions who departed on mission from the same roster were all permitted to pool money for farewell drinking and were granted one day of leave.
translations.idiomatic: In 1012, an edict declared that officials of fifth rank and above in the two departments, fourth rank and above in the Ministry of Personnel, and third rank and above in the various commissions who departed on mission from the same roster might pool money for a farewell feast and receive one day of leave.

sentences.zh: 餘官有親屬僚友出行，任以休務日餞送。

translations.literal: Other officials whose relatives or colleagues traveled were permitted to see them off on days free from official duties.
translations.idiomatic: Other officials whose relatives or colleagues traveled were permitted to see them off on days free from official duties.

sentences.zh: 故事，樞密、節 度使、使相還朝，鹹賜宴於外苑。

translations.literal: By precedent, when Privy Councilors, military commissioners, and commissioners with diplomatic status returned to court, they were all granted banquets in the outer park.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent, when Privy Councilors, military commissioners, and commissioners with diplomatic status returned to court, they were granted banquets in the outer park.

sentences.zh: 見辭日，長春殿賜酒五行，仍設食，當直翰林龍圖閣學士以上、皇親、觀察使預坐。

translations.literal: On the day of farewell audience, five rounds of wine were granted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring, food was also set out, and on-duty Hanlin and Dragon Diagram Pavilion academicians and above, imperial clansmen, and observation commissioners were invited to take seats.
translations.idiomatic: On the day of farewell audience, five rounds of wine were served in the Hall of Everlasting Spring with a meal, and on-duty Hanlin and Dragon Diagram Pavilion academicians and above, imperial clansmen, and observation commissioners were invited to attend.

sentences.zh: 八年四月，侍衛步軍副都指揮使王能自鎮定來 朝，宴於長春殿。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Step Army Wang Neng came to court from Zhending and was banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the eighth year, Vice Commander-in-Chief of the Palace Step Army Wang Neng came to court from Zhending and was banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring.

sentences.zh: 閣門言：“舊制，節度使掌兵，無此禮例。

translations.literal: The Gate Office reported: "By former regulation, military commissioners commanded troops and had no such ritual precedent.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office reported: "Under the former regulations, military commissioners held command of troops and had no such ritual precedent.

sentences.zh: 既赴坐，則殿前馬軍都校當侍立，於品秩非便。

translations.literal: Once they took their seats, the commander of the Palace Cavalry would stand in attendance, which was awkward with regard to rank.
translations.idiomatic: Once they were seated, the commander of the Palace Cavalry had to stand in attendance, which was awkward given rank and precedence.

sentences.zh: ”遂令皆預位。

translations.literal: " Thereupon it was ordered that all take seats in advance.
translations.idiomatic: " The court then ordered that all take seats in advance.

sentences.zh: 中興，仍舊制。

translations.literal: At the Restoration, the former regulations were retained.
translations.idiomatic: During the Restoration, the former regulations remained in force.

sentences.zh: 凡宰相、樞密、執政、使相、節度、外國使見辭及來朝，皆賜宴內殿或都亭驛，或賜茶酒，並如儀。

translations.literal: Whenever prime ministers, privy councilors, chief administrators, commissioners with diplomatic status, military commissioners, or foreign envoys took farewell audiences or came to court, banquets were granted in the inner hall or at the Duyeting Station, or tea and wine were granted—all according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever prime ministers, privy councilors, chief administrators, commissioners with diplomatic status, military commissioners, or foreign envoys took farewell audiences or came to court, they received banquets in the inner hall or at the Duyeting Station, or tea and wine, all according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 時節饋廩。

translations.literal: Seasonal grain gifts.
translations.idiomatic: Seasonal grain gifts.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符五年十一月，以宰相王旦生日，詔賜羊三十口、酒五十壺、米麵各二十斛，令諸司供帳，京府具衙前樂，許宴其親友。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the fifth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, on the birthday of Prime Minister Wang Dan, an edict granted thirty sheep, fifty jars of wine, and twenty hu each of rice and flour; the various offices were ordered to provide furnishings, the capital prefecture to furnish music before the yamen, and he was permitted to banquet his kin and friends.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of 1012, on Prime Minister Wang Dan's birthday, an edict granted thirty sheep, fifty jars of wine, and twenty hu each of rice and flour; the various offices supplied furnishings, the capital prefecture furnished music before the yamen, and he was permitted to host kin and friends at a banquet.

sentences.zh: 旦遂會近列及丞郎、給 諫、修史屬官。

translations.literal: Dan thereupon assembled his close colleagues and directors, gentlemen of attendance and remonstrance, and historiography staff.
translations.idiomatic: Wang Dan then assembled his close colleagues, directors, gentlemen of attendance and remonstrance, and historiography staff.

sentences.zh: 俄又賜樞密使副、參知政事羊三十口，酒三十壺、米麵各三十斛。

translations.literal: Shortly afterward thirty sheep, thirty jars of wine, and thirty hu each of rice and flour were also granted to the Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council and the Participation Councilor.
translations.idiomatic: Shortly afterward the Vice Commissioner of the Privy Council and the Participation Councilor also received thirty sheep, thirty jars of wine, and thirty hu each of rice and flour.

sentences.zh: 其後，以廢務非便，奏罷會，而賜如故。

translations.literal: Afterward, because suspending official duties was inconvenient, they memorialized to abolish the gatherings while the gifts remained as before.
translations.idiomatic: Later, because the gatherings disrupted official business, they memorialized to end the banquets while keeping the gifts unchanged.

sentences.zh: 又製：仆射、御史大夫、中丞、節度、留 後、觀察、內客省使、權知開封府，正、至、寒食，並客省齎簽賜羊、酒、米、麵；

translations.literal: Regulations were further established: for Grand Counselors, Censor-in-Chief, Vice Censor-in-Chief, military commissioners, acting commissioners, observation commissioners, Commissioners of the Inner Reception Bureau, and those acting as Administrator of the Kaifeng Metropolitan Prefecture—at New Year's, Winter Solstice, and Cold Food Festival—the Guest Reception Bureau would deliver signed lists granting sheep, wine, rice, and flour;
translations.idiomatic: Further regulations were issued: Grand Counselors, the Censor-in-Chief, the Vice Censor-in-Chief, military commissioners, acting commissioners, observation commissioners, Commissioners of the Inner Reception Bureau, and acting Administrators of Kaifeng received sheep, wine, rice, and flour at New Year's, Winter Solstice, and Cold Food, delivered on signed lists from the Guest Reception Bureau;

sentences.zh: 立春賜春盤；

translations.literal: at Start of Spring, spring plates were granted;
translations.idiomatic: at Start of Spring, spring plates;

sentences.zh: 寒食神餤、餳粥；

translations.literal: at Cold Food, spirit cakes and malt syrup porridge;
translations.idiomatic: at Cold Food, spirit cakes and malt syrup porridge;

sentences.zh: 端午粽子；

translations.literal: at Double Fifth, rice dumplings;
translations.idiomatic: at Double Fifth, rice dumplings;

sentences.zh: 伏日蜜沙冰；

translations.literal: at Start of Dog Days, honey-sand ice;
translations.idiomatic: at the start of the dog days, honey-sand ice;

sentences.zh: 重陽糕，並有酒；

translations.literal: at Double Ninth, cakes, with wine in each case;
translations.idiomatic: at Double Ninth, cakes, each with wine;

sentences.zh: 三伏 日，又五日一賜冰。

translations.literal: during the three phases of dog days, ice was also granted every five days.
translations.idiomatic: during the three dog-day phases, ice was also granted every five days.

sentences.zh: 四廂及廂都指揮使，中書舍人，統軍，防禦、團練使，刺史，客省使，樞密都承旨，知銀台司、審刑院，三司勾院，諸司使，禁軍校、忠佐，海 外諸蕃進奉領刺史以上，至寒食，並賜節料；

translations.literal: for commanders of the four wings and wing commanders-in-chief, Secretariat Drafters, army supervisors, defense and training commissioners, prefects, Guest Reception commissioners, Chief Receiver of the Privy Council, Directors of the Silver Terrace Office and Review Office, commissioners of the three departments' audit offices, various bureau commissioners, forbidden-army officers and loyal aides, and foreign tribute envoys from beyond the seas holding prefectural rank and above—at Cold Food, all received seasonal provisions;
translations.idiomatic: Commanders of the four wings and wing commanders-in-chief, Secretariat drafters, army supervisors, defense and training commissioners, prefects, Guest Reception commissioners, the Privy Council chief receiver, directors of the Silver Terrace and Review offices, three-department audit commissioners, various bureau commissioners, forbidden-army officers and loyal aides, and overseas tribute envoys of prefectural rank and above all received seasonal provisions at Cold Food;

sentences.zh: 立春，奉內朝者皆賜幡勝。

translations.literal: at Start of Spring, all who attended the inner court received banner streamers.
translations.idiomatic: at Start of Spring, all who attended the inner court received banner streamers.

sentences.zh: 元祐二年十一月冬至，詔賜禦筵於呂公著私第，遣中使賜上尊酒、香藥、果實、縷金花等，以禦飲器勸酒，遣教坊樂工，給內帑錢賜之。

translations.literal: On Winter Solstice in the eleventh month of the second year of Yuanyou, an edict granted an imperial banquet at Lü Gongzhu's private residence; palace envoys were sent with imperial wine, incense and medicines, fruits, gold-thread flowers, and the like; imperial drinking vessels were used to urge wine; Music Bureau performers were dispatched; and funds from the inner treasury were granted.
translations.idiomatic: On Winter Solstice in the eleventh month of 1087, the court granted an imperial banquet at Lü Gongzhu's private residence, sending palace envoys with imperial wine, incense and medicines, fruit, gold-thread flowers, and the like; imperial drinking vessels urged the toasts; Music Bureau performers performed; and funds from the inner treasury were granted.

sentences.zh: 及暮賜燭，傳宣令繼燭，皆異恩也。

translations.literal: At evening candles were granted, and an imperial message ordered continuation of candles—all extraordinary favors.
translations.idiomatic: At evening they received candles, and an imperial message ordered more candles supplied—each an extraordinary favor.

sentences.zh: 紹興十三年十二月二十三日，高宗賜宰臣秦檜詔曰：“省所奏辭免生日賜宴。

translations.literal: On the twenty-third day of the twelfth month of the thirteenth year of Shaoxing, Emperor Gaozong granted Prime Minister Qin Hui an edict saying: "The ministry reports your request to decline a birthday banquet.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-third day of the twelfth month of 1143, Emperor Gaozong granted Prime Minister Qin Hui an edict: "The ministry reports your request to decline a birthday banquet.

sentences.zh: 朕聞賢聖之興必五百歲，君臣之遇蓋亦千載。

translations.literal: I have heard that the rise of the worthy and sage must come every five hundred years, and the meeting of ruler and minister is surely once in a millennium.
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that the rise of the worthy and sage comes once in five hundred years, and a meeting of ruler and minister once in a millennium.

sentences.zh: 夫以不世之英，值難逢之會，則其始生 之日，可不為天下慶乎！

translations.literal: When an age-defying hero meets a hard-to-find occasion, can the day of his birth not be celebrated for the realm!
translations.idiomatic: When a hero of the age meets an occasion that may never come again, should not the day of his birth be celebrated throughout the realm!

sentences.zh: 式燕樂衎，所以示慶也。

translations.literal: A feast with music and ease is how celebration is shown.
translations.idiomatic: A feast with music and ease is how the court shows its celebration.

sentences.zh: 非喬嶽之神無以生申、甫，非宣王之能任賢無以致中興。

translations.literal: Without the spirit of lofty mountains there is no birth of Shen and Fu; without King Xuan's ability to employ the worthy there is no bringing about of restoration.
translations.idiomatic: Without the spirit of lofty mountains there is no birth of Shen and Fu; without King Xuan's ability to employ the worthy there is no restoration.

sentences.zh: 今日之事，不亦臣主俱榮哉？

translations.literal: Is not today's affair glory shared by ruler and minister alike?
translations.idiomatic: Is not today's affair a glory shared alike by ruler and minister?

sentences.zh: 宜服異恩，毋守衝節。

translations.literal: You should accept this extraordinary favor; do not cling to excessive modesty.
translations.idiomatic: Accept this extraordinary favor; do not cling to excessive modesty.

sentences.zh: 所請 宜不允。

translations.literal: Your request should not be granted.
translations.idiomatic: Your request is not granted.

sentences.zh: 宋朝之製，凡外國使至，及其君長來朝，皆宴於內殿，近臣及刺史、正郎、都虞候以上皆預。

translations.literal: Under Song regulations, whenever foreign envoys arrived, and whenever their rulers came to court, banquets were held in the inner hall; close ministers and officials of prefectural rank, Regular Gentleman, and Chief Commandant and above all attended.
translations.idiomatic: Under Song regulations, whenever foreign envoys arrived or their rulers came to court, banquets were held in the inner hall, with close ministers and officials of prefectural rank, Regular Gentleman, and Chief Commandant and above in attendance.

sentences.zh: 太祖建隆元年八月三日，宴近臣於廣政殿，江南、吳越朝貢使皆預。

translations.literal: On the third day of the eighth month of the first year of Jianlong, close ministers were banqueted in the Hall of Broad Governance, with tribute envoys from Jiangnan and Wuyue also attending.
translations.idiomatic: On the third day of the eighth month of the first year of Jianlong, close ministers were banqueted in the Hall of Broad Governance, with tribute envoys from Jiangnan and Wuyue in attendance.

sentences.zh: 乾德三年五月十六日，宴近臣及孟昶於大明殿。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the fifth month of the third year of Qiande, close ministers and Meng Chang were banqueted in the Hall of Great Brightness.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the fifth month of the third year of Qiande, close ministers and Meng Chang were banqueted in the Hall of Great Brightness.

sentences.zh: 開寶四年五月七日，宴近臣及劉鋹於崇德殿。

translations.literal: On the seventh day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Kaibao, close ministers and Liu Chang were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the seventh day of the fifth month of the fourth year of Kaibao, close ministers and Liu Chang were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.

sentences.zh: 十一月五日，江南李煜、吳越錢俶各遣子弟來朝，宴於崇德殿。

translations.literal: On the fifth day of the eleventh month, Li Yu of Jiangnan and Qian Chu of Wuyue each sent sons to court; they were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day of the eleventh month, Li Yu of Jiangnan and Qian Chu of Wuyue each sent sons to court and were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.

sentences.zh: 八年三月晦，宴契丹使於長春殿。

translations.literal: On the last day of the third month of the eighth year, Khitan envoys were banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring.
translations.idiomatic: On the last day of the third month of the eighth year, Khitan envoys were banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring.

sentences.zh: 太平興國二年二月十一日，宴兩浙進奉使、契丹國信使及李煜、劉鋹、禁軍都指揮使以上於崇德殿，不舉樂，酒七行而罷。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day of the second month of the second year of Taiping Xingguo, tribute envoys from the two Zhejiangs, credentialed Khitan envoys, Li Yu, Liu Chang, and commanders-in-chief of the forbidden armies and above were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue; music was not performed, and the banquet ended after seven rounds of wine.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the second month of 977, tribute envoys from the two Zhejiangs, credentialed Khitan envoys, Li Yu, Liu Chang, and forbidden-army commanders-in-chief and above were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue without music; the banquet ended after seven rounds of wine.

sentences.zh: 契丹遣使賀登極也。

translations.literal: The Khitan had sent envoys to congratulate the accession.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan had sent envoys to congratulate the accession.

sentences.zh: 五月十一日，再宴 契丹使於崇德殿，酒九行而罷，以其貢助山陵也。

translations.literal: On the eleventh day of the fifth month, Khitan envoys were again banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue; the banquet ended after nine rounds of wine, because they had presented tribute to assist with the imperial tomb.
translations.idiomatic: On the eleventh day of the fifth month, Khitan envoys were again banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue; the banquet ended after nine rounds of wine because their tribute assisted with the imperial tomb.

sentences.zh: 三年正月十六日，宴劉鋹、李煜、契丹使、諸國蕃客於崇德殿，以契丹使來賀正故也。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the first month of the third year, Liu Chang, Li Yu, Khitan envoys, and foreign guests from the various states were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue, because Khitan envoys had come to congratulate the New Year.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the first month of the third year, Liu Chang, Li Yu, Khitan envoys, and foreign guests from the various states were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue because Khitan envoys had come to congratulate the New Year.

sentences.zh: 三月二十五日，吳越錢俶來 朝，宴於長春殿，親王、宰相、節度使、劉鋹、李煜皆預。

translations.literal: On the twenty-fifth day of the third month, Qian Chu of Wuyue came to court and was banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring; imperial princes, prime ministers, military commissioners, Liu Chang, and Li Yu all attended.
translations.idiomatic: On the twenty-fifth day of the third month, Qian Chu of Wuyue came to court and was banqueted in the Hall of Everlasting Spring, with imperial princes, prime ministers, military commissioners, Liu Chang, and Li Yu in attendance.

sentences.zh: 十月十六日，宴宰相、親王以下及契丹使、高麗使、諸州進奉使於崇德殿，以乾明節罷大宴故也。

translations.literal: On the sixteenth day of the tenth month, prime ministers, imperial princes and below, Khitan envoys, Goryeo envoys, and tribute envoys from the various prefectures were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue, because the great banquet for the Qianming Festival had been canceled.
translations.idiomatic: On the sixteenth day of the tenth month, prime ministers, imperial princes and below, Khitan envoys, Goryeo envoys, and prefectural tribute envoys were banqueted in the Hall of Honoring Virtue because the great banquet for the Qianming Festival had been canceled.

sentences.zh: 是後， 宴外國使為常。

translations.literal: After this, banqueting foreign envoys became customary.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter, banquets for foreign envoys became routine.

sentences.zh: 其君長來朝，先遣使迎勞於候館，使者朝服稱製曰“奉制勞某主”，國主迎於門外，與使者俱入升階，使者執束帛，稱有制，國主北面 再拜稽首受幣，又再拜稽首，以土物儐，使者再拜受。

translations.literal: When their rulers came to court, envoys were first sent ahead to welcome and comfort them at the guest lodge; the envoy wore court dress and, citing the imperial command, said "By imperial command, I comfort Lord So-and-so"; the ruler welcomed him outside the gate, and both entered and ascended the steps together; the envoy held a bundle of silk, declared that there was an imperial command, and the ruler faced north, bowed twice, touched his forehead to the ground, and received the gifts; he bowed twice again and touched his forehead to the ground, presented local products in return, and the envoy bowed twice to receive them.
translations.idiomatic: When a foreign ruler came to court, envoys were first sent to welcome him at the guest lodge; the envoy wore court dress and, citing the imperial command, said, "By imperial command, I comfort Lord So-and-so." The ruler welcomed him outside the gate, and both entered and ascended the steps; the envoy held a bundle of silk, declared an imperial command, and the ruler faced north, bowed twice, touched his forehead to the ground, and received the gifts; he bowed twice again, touched his forehead to the ground, presented local products in return, and the envoy bowed twice to receive them.

sentences.zh: 國主送使者出，鴻臚引詣朝堂，所司奏聞，通事舍人承敕宣勞，再拜就館。

translations.literal: The ruler escorted the envoy out; the Director of Banquets led him to the court hall, the relevant office reported it, and the Protocol Gentleman, receiving the edict, announced comfort; he bowed twice and returned to the lodge.
translations.idiomatic: The ruler escorted the envoy out; the Director of Banquets led him to the court hall, the relevant office reported it, and the Protocol Gentleman, receiving the edict, announced comfort; he bowed twice and returned to the lodge.

sentences.zh: 翌日，遣使戒見日如儀。

translations.literal: The next day, envoys were sent to announce the audience day according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The next day, envoys announced the audience day according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 又次日， 奉見於乾元殿，設黃麾仗及宮縣大樂。

translations.literal: On the following day they were received in audience at the Hall of Qianyuan, with yellow imperial guards arrayed and full palace music.
translations.idiomatic: On the following day they were received in audience at the Hall of Qianyuan, with yellow imperial guards arrayed and full palace music.

sentences.zh: 典儀設國主位於縣南道西北向，又設其國諸官之位於其後。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies set the ruler's seat south of the music stands, facing northwest, and also set seats for officials of his state behind him.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonies placed the ruler's seat south of the music stands, facing northwest, and set seats for his state's officials behind him.

sentences.zh: 所司迎引，國主服其國服，至明德門外，通事舍人引就位。

translations.literal: The relevant office escorted him in; the ruler wore his state's dress, reached the outside of the Gate of Illustrious Virtue, and the Protocol Gentleman led him to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant office escorted him in; the ruler wore his state's dress, reached the outside of the Gate of Illustrious Virtue, and the Protocol Gentleman led him to his place.

sentences.zh: 侍中奏 中嚴，皇帝服通天冠、絳紗袍，出自西房，即御位。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant reported the inner vigil; the emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, came forth from the west chamber, and took the imperial seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported the inner vigil; the emperor wore the Tongtian crown and crimson gauze robe, came from the west chamber, and took the throne.

sentences.zh: 典儀讚拜，國主再拜稽首。

translations.literal: The Master of Ceremonies intoned the bow; the ruler bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground.
translations.idiomatic: The Master of Ceremonies intoned the bow; the ruler bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground.

sentences.zh: 侍中承製降勞，皆再拜稽首，敕升坐，又再拜稽首，至坐，俯伏避席。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, descended to comfort him; all bowed twice and touched their foreheads to the ground; he was ordered to ascend and take a seat; they bowed twice again and touched their foreheads to the ground; upon reaching the seat they bowed low and left the mat.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, descended to comfort him; all bowed twice and touched their foreheads to the ground; he was ordered to ascend and be seated; they bowed twice again and touched their foreheads to the ground; upon reaching the seat they bowed low and left the mat.

sentences.zh: 侍中承製曰“ 無下拜”，國主復位。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, said "Do not descend to bow"; the ruler returned to his place.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant, receiving the command, said, "Do not descend to bow"; the ruler returned to his place.

sentences.zh: 次引其國諸官以次入，就位，再拜並如上儀。

translations.literal: Next his state's officials were led in one after another, took their places, and bowed twice according to the same protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Next his state's officials were led in one after another, took their places, and bowed twice according to the same protocol.

sentences.zh: 侍中又承製勞還館，通事舍人引國主降，復位，再拜稽首，出。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant again received the command to comfort him on returning to the lodge; the Protocol Gentleman led the ruler down, he returned to his place, bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground, and withdrew.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant again received the command to comfort him on returning to the lodge; the Protocol Gentleman led the ruler down; he returned to his place, bowed twice and touched his forehead to the ground, and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 其國諸官皆再拜，以次出。

translations.literal: All officials of his state bowed twice and withdrew in turn.
translations.idiomatic: All officials of his state bowed twice and withdrew in turn.

sentences.zh: 侍中 奏禮畢，皇帝降坐。

translations.literal: The Palace Attendant reported that the rites were complete, and the emperor descended from the seat.
translations.idiomatic: The Palace Attendant reported that the rites were complete, and the emperor left the throne.

sentences.zh: 其錫宴與受諸國使表及幣皆有儀，具載《開寶通禮》。

translations.literal: The grant of banquets, reception of memorials and gifts from the various states, and all protocols are fully recorded in the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao.
translations.idiomatic: Banquets, reception of memorials and gifts from the various states, and all related protocols are fully recorded in the Comprehensive Rites of Kaibao.

sentences.zh: 契丹國使入聘見辭儀。

translations.literal: Protocol for Khitan envoys on mission for audience and farewell.
translations.idiomatic: Protocol for Khitan envoys on mission for audience and farewell.

sentences.zh: 自景德澶淵會盟之後，始有契丹國信使副元正、聖節朝見。

translations.literal: After the Chanyuan covenant of Jingde, credentialed Khitan deputy envoys began to attend audiences on New Year's Day and the imperial birthday.
translations.idiomatic: After the Chanyuan covenant of 1005, credentialed Khitan deputy envoys began to attend audiences on New Year's Day and the imperial birthday.

sentences.zh: 大中祥符九年，有司遂定儀注。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Dazhong Xiangfu, the relevant office fixed the ritual regulations.
translations.idiomatic: In 1016, the relevant office fixed the ritual regulations.

sentences.zh: 前一日，習儀於驛。

translations.literal: On the day before, they rehearsed the protocol at the station.
translations.idiomatic: On the day before, they rehearsed the protocol at the station.

sentences.zh: 見日，皇帝御崇德殿。

translations.literal: On the audience day, the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.
translations.idiomatic: On the audience day, the emperor took the throne in the Hall of Honoring Virtue.

sentences.zh: 宰臣、樞密使以下大班起居訖，至員僚起居後，館伴使副一班入就位，東面立。

translations.literal: After prime ministers, the Commissioner of the Privy Council, and those below had finished the grand audience bow in the great formation, and after the staff formation had finished its audience bow, the hosting deputy envoys entered in one formation and took their places, standing on the east.
translations.idiomatic: After prime ministers, the Commissioner of the Privy Council, and those below finished the grand audience bow in the great formation, and after the staff formation finished its audience bow, the hosting deputy envoys entered in one formation and stood on the east.

sentences.zh: 次接書匣閣門使升殿立。

translations.literal: Next the Gate Commissioner who received the document casket ascended and stood.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Gate Commissioner who received the document casket ascended and stood.

sentences.zh: 次通事入，不 通，喝拜，兩拜，奏聖躬萬福，又喝兩拜，隨呼萬歲，喝祗候，赴東西接引使副位。

translations.literal: Next the interpreter entered, did not announce, was shouted to bow, bowed twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, was again shouted to bow twice, followed by shouting ten thousand years, shouted to attend, and went to the east and west receiving deputy envoys' places.
translations.idiomatic: Next the interpreter entered without announcement, was commanded to bow, bowed twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, was commanded to bow twice again, followed by shouts of ten thousand years, was told to attend, and went to the east and west receiving deputy envoys' places.

sentences.zh: 舍人引契丹使副自外捧書匣入，當殿前立。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman led the Khitan deputy envoys in from outside bearing the document casket and stood before the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman led the Khitan deputy envoys in from outside bearing the document casket and had them stand before the hall.

sentences.zh: 天武官抬禮物分東西向入，列於殿 下，以東為上。

translations.literal: Heavenly Martial officers carried tribute gifts in, divided east and west, and arrayed them below the hall, with east as superior.
translations.idiomatic: Heavenly Martial officers carried tribute gifts in, divided east and west, and arrayed them below the hall, with the east side superior.

sentences.zh: 舍人喝天武官起居，兩拜，隨呼萬歲，奏聖躬萬福，喝各祗候。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman shouted for the Heavenly Martial officers to perform the audience bow; they bowed twice, followed by shouting ten thousand years, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, and shouted for each to attend.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman commanded the Heavenly Martial officers to perform the audience bow; they bowed twice, shouted ten thousand years, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, and were told to attend.

sentences.zh: 閣門從東階降，至契丹使位北。

translations.literal: The Gate Office descended from the east steps to north of the Khitan envoys' place.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Office descended from the east steps to north of the Khitan envoys' place.

sentences.zh: 舍人揖使跪進書匣，閣門側身搢笏、跪接，舍人受 之。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman motioned the envoys to kneel and present the document casket; the Gate Commissioner turned aside, inserted his tablet, knelt to receive it, and the Protocol Gentleman took it.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman motioned the envoys to kneel and present the document casket; the Gate Commissioner turned aside, inserted his tablet, knelt to receive it, and the Protocol Gentleman took it.

sentences.zh: 契丹使立，閣門執笏捧書匣升殿，當御前進呈訖，授內侍都知，都知拆書以授宰臣，宰臣、樞密進呈訖，遂抬禮物出。

translations.literal: The Khitan envoys stood; the Gate Commissioner, holding his tablet, bore the document casket up the hall, presented it before the throne, handed it to the Chief Palace Attendant, who opened the letter and gave it to the prime minister; after the prime minister and Privy Council presented it, the tribute gifts were carried out.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan envoys stood; the Gate Commissioner, holding his tablet, bore the document casket up the hall, presented it before the throne, and handed it to the Chief Palace Attendant, who opened the letter and gave it to the prime minister; after the prime minister and Privy Council presented it, the tribute gifts were carried out.

sentences.zh: 舍人與館伴使副引契丹使副至東階下，閣 門使下殿揖引同升，立御前。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman and hosting deputy envoys led the Khitan deputy envoys to below the east steps; the Gate Commissioner descended, motioned, and led them up together to stand before the throne.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman and hosting deputy envoys led the Khitan deputy envoys to below the east steps; the Gate Commissioner descended, motioned, and led them up together to stand before the throne.

sentences.zh: 至國信大使傳國主問聖體，通事傳譯，舍人當御前鞠躬傳奏訖，揖起北使。

translations.literal: When the credentialed chief envoy conveyed the Khitan ruler's inquiry after the Sage's person, the interpreter translated; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the throne, reported and finished, then motioned the northern envoy to rise.
translations.idiomatic: When the credentialed chief envoy conveyed the Khitan ruler's inquiry after the Sage's person, the interpreter translated; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the throne, reported, finished, and motioned the northern envoy to rise.

sentences.zh: 皇帝宣閣門回問國主，北使跪奏，舍人當御前鞠躬奏訖，遂 揖北使起，卻引降階至辭見位，麵西揖躬。

translations.literal: The emperor ordered the Gate Office to inquire after the Khitan ruler in return; the northern envoy knelt and reported; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the throne, reported and finished, then motioned the northern envoy to rise, led him down the steps to the farewell audience place, and bowed at the waist facing west.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Gate Office to inquire after the Khitan ruler in return; the northern envoy knelt and reported; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the throne, reported, finished, and motioned the northern envoy to rise, led him down the steps to the farewell audience place, and bowed at the waist facing west.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿通北朝國信使某官某祗候見，應喏絕，引當殿，喝拜，大起居

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman announced before the hall the credentialed envoy of the Northern Court, Officer So-and-so, attending for audience; at each command he responded; he was led before the hall, shouted to bow, and performed the grand audience bow
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman announced before the hall the credentialed envoy of the Northern Court, Officer So-and-so, attending for audience; at each command he responded; he was led before the hall, commanded to bow, and performed the grand audience bow

sentences.zh: （其拜舞並依本國禮）〉

translations.literal: (their bows and dances all followed their state's rites)
translations.idiomatic: (their bows and dances all followed their state's rites)

sentences.zh: ，出班謝麵天顏，歸位，喝 拜舞蹈訖，又出班謝沿路驛館禦筵茶藥及傳宣撫問，復歸位，喝拜舞蹈訖，舍人宣有敕賜窄衣一對、金蹀躞子一、金塗銀冠一、靴一兩、衣著三百匹、銀二百兩、鞍 轡馬一

translations.literal: , stepped forward from the formation to thank him for viewing the heavenly countenance, returned to place, was shouted to bow and dance and finished, again stepped forward to thank him for imperial banquets of tea and medicines at relay stations along the route and for comforting messages transmitted, returned to place, was shouted to bow and dance and finished; the Protocol Gentleman announced that there was an edict granting one pair of narrow robes, one set of golden diexiezi, one gold-plated silver crown, one pair of boots, three hundred bolts of clothing, two hundred taels of silver, and one saddle, bridle, and horse
translations.idiomatic: , stepped forward from the formation to thank him for viewing the heavenly countenance, returned to place, was commanded to bow and dance and finished, stepped forward again to thank him for imperial banquets of tea and medicines at relay stations along the route and for comforting messages transmitted, returned to place, was commanded to bow and dance and finished; the Protocol Gentleman announced an edict granting one pair of narrow robes, one set of golden diexiezi, one gold-plated silver crown, one pair of boots, three hundred bolts of clothing, two hundred taels of silver, and one saddle, bridle, and horse

sentences.zh: （每句應喏）〉

translations.literal: (at each phrase he responded to the command)
translations.idiomatic: (at each phrase he responded to the command)

sentences.zh: ，跪受，起，拜舞蹈訖，喝祗候，應喏西出

translations.literal: , knelt to receive, rose, bowed and danced and finished, was shouted to attend, responded to the command, and exited to the west
translations.idiomatic: , knelt to receive, rose, bowed and danced and finished, was told to attend, responded to the command, and exited to the west

sentences.zh: （凡傳語並奏聖躬萬福、致辭，並通事傳譯，舍人當殿鞠躬奏聞，後同）〉

translations.literal: (whenever words were transmitted, and whenever the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings and formal addresses were reported, the interpreter always translated; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the hall, reported, and heard—the same hereafter)
translations.idiomatic: (whenever words were transmitted, and whenever the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings and formal addresses were reported, the interpreter always translated; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist before the hall, reported, and heard—the same hereafter)

sentences.zh: 次通北朝國信副使某官某 祗候見，其拜舞、謝賜、致詞並如上儀，西出

translations.literal: Next the credentialed deputy envoy of the Northern Court, Officer So-and-so, was announced attending for audience; his bows and dances, thanks for gifts, and formal addresses all followed the protocol above, and he exited to the west
