translations.idiomatic: Next the credentialed deputy envoy of the Northern Court, Officer So-and-so, was announced attending for audience; his bows and dances, thanks for gifts, and formal addresses all followed the protocol above, and he exited to the west

sentences.zh: （其敕賜衣一對，金腰帶一，襆頭、靴、笏、衣著二百匹，銀器一百兩，鞍轡馬一）〉

translations.literal: (the edict granted one pair of robes, one golden belt, one turban, boots, tablet, two hundred bolts of clothing, one hundred taels of silverware, and one saddle, bridle, and horse)
translations.idiomatic: (the edict granted one pair of robes, one golden belt, one turban, boots, tablet, two hundred bolts of clothing, one hundred taels of silverware, and one saddle, bridle, and horse)

sentences.zh: 次通事及舍人引舍利已下分班 入，不通，便引合班，讚喝大起居，拜舞如儀。

translations.literal: Next the interpreter and Protocol Gentleman led Shili and those below in divided formations; without announcement they were led into a combined formation; the intoner shouted the grand audience bow, and they bowed and danced according to protocol.
translations.idiomatic: Next the interpreter and Protocol Gentleman led Shili and those below in divided formations; without announcement they were led into a combined formation; the intoner commanded the grand audience bow, and they bowed and danced according to protocol.

sentences.zh: 舍人喝有敕賜衣服、束帶、衣著、銀器分物，應喏跪受，抬擔床絕，起，舞蹈拜訖，喝各祗候分班引出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman shouted that there was an edict granting robes, belts, clothing, and divided silverware; they responded to the command, knelt to receive, the carrying couch was withdrawn, they rose, bowed and danced and finished, were shouted to attend, and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman announced an edict granting robes, belts, clothing, and divided silverware; they responded to the command, knelt to receive, the carrying couch was withdrawn, they rose, bowed and danced and finished, were told to attend, and were led out in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 次引差來通 事以下從人分班入，不通，便引合班，喝兩拜，奏聖躬萬福，又拜，隨呼萬歲，喝有敕各賜衣服、腰帶、衣著、銀器分物，應喏跪受，起，喝兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝各 祗候唱喏分班引出。

translations.literal: Next envoys sent on assignment and attendants below them were led in in divided formations; without announcement they were led into a combined formation, shouted to bow twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, bowed again, followed by shouting ten thousand years; there was an edict granting each robes, belt, clothing, and divided silverware; they responded to the command, knelt to receive, rose, were shouted to bow twice, followed by bowing ten thousand years, were shouted to attend and respond to the command, and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: Next envoys sent on assignment and attendants below them were led in in divided formations; without announcement they were led into a combined formation, commanded to bow twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, bowed again, and shouted ten thousand years; an edict granted each robes, belt, clothing, and divided silverware; they responded to the command, knelt to receive, rose, were commanded to bow twice, bowed ten thousand years, were told to attend and respond to the command, and were led out in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 次行門、殿直入，起居訖，殿上侍立。

translations.literal: Next the gate guards and palace attendants entered, performed the audience bow and finished, and stood attending in the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Next the gate guards and palace attendants entered, performed the audience bow, and stood attending in the hall.

sentences.zh: 文明殿樞密直學士、三司使、內客省使下殿。

translations.literal: Academicians Ex Officio of the Hall of Civil Splendor, commissioners of the three departments, and Commissioners of the Inner Reception Bureau descended from the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians Ex Officio of the Hall of Civil Splendor, commissioners of the three departments, and Commissioners of the Inner Reception Bureau left the hall.

sentences.zh: 舍人合班奏報閣門無事，唱喏訖，卷班西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman combined formations and reported to the Gate Office that there was no further business; after responding to the command they rolled formation and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman combined formations and reported to the Gate Office that there was no further business; after responding to the command they rolled formation and exited to the west.

sentences.zh: 客省、閣門使 以下東出，其排立，供奉官已下橫行合班。

translations.literal: Guest Reception and Gate Commissioners and those below exited to the east; they lined up, and supply officers and below formed a transverse combined formation.
translations.idiomatic: Guest Reception and Gate Commissioners and those below exited to the east; they lined up, and supply officers and below formed a transverse combined formation.

sentences.zh: 宣徽使殿上喝供奉官已下各祗候分班出，並如常儀。

translations.literal: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat shouted from the hall for supply officers and below each to attend and be led out in divided formations—all according to ordinary protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The Commissioner of the Palace Secretariat shouted from the hall for supply officers and below each to attend and be led out in divided formations—all according to ordinary protocol.

sentences.zh: 皇帝降坐還內。

translations.literal: The emperor descended from the seat and returned within.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor left the throne and returned within.

sentences.zh: 宴日，契丹使副以下服所賜，承受引赴 長春殿門外，並侍宴臣僚宰執、親王、樞密使以下祗候。

translations.literal: On the banquet day, Khitan deputy envoys and those below wore what had been granted; receiving officers led them outside the Gate of the Hall of Everlasting Spring, and attending banquet officials—prime ministers, imperial princes, the Commissioner of the Privy Council, and those below—stood ready.
translations.idiomatic: On the banquet day, Khitan deputy envoys and those below wore what had been granted; receiving officers led them outside the Gate of the Hall of Everlasting Spring, while prime ministers, imperial princes, the Commissioner of the Privy Council, and other attending officials stood ready.

sentences.zh: 俟長春殿諸司排當有備，閣門使附入內都知奏班齊，皇帝坐，鳴鞭，宰臣、親王以下並宰執分班，舍人引 入。

translations.literal: When the various offices had finished arranging the Hall of Everlasting Spring and all was ready, the Gate Commissioner reported through the Chief Palace Attendant within that the formations were complete; the emperor took his seat, the whip sounded, prime ministers and imperial princes and below together with chief administrators entered in divided formations, and the Protocol Gentleman led them in.
translations.idiomatic: When the various offices had finished arranging the Hall of Everlasting Spring and all was ready, the Gate Commissioner reported through the Chief Palace Attendant that the formations were complete; the emperor took his seat, the whip sounded, and prime ministers, imperial princes, chief administrators, and those below entered in divided formations as the Protocol Gentleman led them in.

sentences.zh: 其契丹使副綴親王班入。

translations.literal: The Khitan deputy envoys joined the imperial princes' formation in entering.
translations.idiomatic: The Khitan deputy envoys entered in formation with the imperial princes.

sentences.zh: 舍人通某甲以下，唱喏，班首奏聖躬萬福，喝各就坐、兩拜，隨呼萬歲，喝就坐，分班引上殿。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman announced So-and-so and those below; they responded to the command; the formation chief reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings; they were shouted to each take seat and bow twice, followed by shouting ten thousand years, shouted to take seat, and led up to the hall in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman announced So-and-so and those below; they responded to the command; the formation chief reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings; they were commanded to take their seats and bow twice, then shouted "Ten thousand years!"; commanded to be seated, they were led up to the hall in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 或皇帝撫問契丹使副，舍人便引下殿， 喝兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝各就坐。

translations.literal: If the emperor inquired of the Khitan deputy envoys, the Protocol Gentleman at once led them down from the hall, shouted for two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, and shouted for each to take seat.
translations.idiomatic: If the emperor addressed the Khitan deputy envoys, the Protocol Gentleman at once led them down from the hall, commanded two bows, they bowed ten thousand years, and were commanded to take their seats again.

sentences.zh: 次舍人、通事分引舍利以下東西分班，喝兩拜，喝就坐，分引赴兩廊下。

translations.literal: Next the Protocol Gentleman and interpreter separately led Shili and those below in east and west divided formations, shouted for two bows, shouted to take seat, and separately led them to the two corridors below.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Protocol Gentleman and interpreter separately led Shili and those below in east and west formations, commanded two bows and to be seated, then led them to the two side corridors.

sentences.zh: 次舍人引差來通事、從人東西分班入，合班，喝兩拜，隨拜 萬歲，喝就坐，分引赴兩廊。

translations.literal: Next the Protocol Gentleman led envoys sent on assignment and attendants in east and west divided formations to enter, combined formation, shouted for two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted to take seat, and separately led them to the two corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Protocol Gentleman led assigned envoys and attendants in east and west formations; they combined, were commanded to bow twice and shout ten thousand years, were seated, and were led to the two corridors.

sentences.zh: 次喝教坊已下兩拜，班首奏聖躬萬福，又喝拜，兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝各祗候。

translations.literal: Next the Music Bureau and those below were shouted to bow twice; the formation chief reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings; again shouted to bow, two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted for each to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Music Bureau and those below were commanded to bow twice; the formation chief reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings; they bowed again twice, shouted ten thousand years, and were told to attend.

sentences.zh: 次引看盞二人稍近前，喝拜，兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝上殿祗 候，分東西上殿立。

translations.literal: Next the two cup-watchers were led slightly forward, shouted to bow, two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted to attend in the hall, and separately stood on the east and west of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: Next the two cup-watchers were led slightly forward, commanded to bow twice and shout ten thousand years, told to attend in the hall, and took their stations on the east and west sides.

sentences.zh: 有司進茶床，內侍酹酒，訖，閣門使殿上御前鞠躬奏某甲已下進酒，餘如常儀。

translations.literal: The relevant offices advanced the tea couch; palace attendants poured the libation; when finished, the Gate Commissioner bowed at the waist before the emperor in the hall and reported that So-and-so and those below presented wine—the rest according to ordinary protocol.
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices advanced the tea couch; palace attendants poured the libation; when finished, the Gate Commissioner bowed before the emperor in the hall and reported that So-and-so and those below presented wine—the rest according to ordinary protocol.

sentences.zh: 宴起，宰臣已下降階，舍人喝兩拜，搢笏，舞蹈，喝各祗候，分 班出。

translations.literal: When the banquet rose, after prime ministers had descended the steps, the Protocol Gentleman shouted for two bows; they inserted their tablets, performed the dance, were shouted for each to attend, and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: When the banquet ended and prime ministers had left the steps, the Protocol Gentleman commanded two bows; they inserted their tablets, performed the dance, were told to attend, and exited in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 次舍利合班，喝兩拜，舞蹈，三拜，拜謝訖，喝各祗候分引出。

translations.literal: Next Shili combined formation, shouted for two bows, dance, three bows; when thanks for bowing was finished, shouted for each to attend and led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: Next Shili combined formation, were commanded to bow twice, dance, and bow three times; when their thanks were finished, they were told to attend and were led out in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 次通事、從人合班，喝兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝各祗候，分班引出。

translations.literal: Next interpreters and attendants combined formation, shouted for two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted for each to attend, and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: Next interpreters and attendants combined formation, bowed twice, shouted ten thousand years, were told to attend, and were led out in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 次喝教坊使已下兩拜，隨拜萬 歲，喝各祗候。

translations.literal: Next the Director of the Music Bureau and those below were shouted to bow twice, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted for each to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Director of the Music Bureau and those below were commanded to bow twice, shout ten thousand years, and attend.

sentences.zh: 如傳宣賜茶酒，又喝謝茶酒拜，兩拜，隨拜萬歲，喝各祗候，出。

translations.literal: If an edict was transmitted granting tea and wine, again shouted the thanks-for-tea-and-wine bow, two bows, followed by bowing ten thousand years, shouted for each to attend, and they exited.
translations.idiomatic: If an edict granted tea and wine, they were again commanded in the thanks-for-tea-and-wine bow, bowed twice, shouted ten thousand years, were told to attend, and exited.

sentences.zh: 閣門使殿上近前側奏無事，皇帝降坐，鳴鞭還內。

translations.literal: The Gate Commissioner advanced to the side before the hall and reported that there was no further business; the emperor descended from the seat, the whip sounded, and he returned within.
translations.idiomatic: The Gate Commissioner advanced to the side of the hall and reported that there was no further business; the emperor left the throne, the whip sounded, and he returned within.

sentences.zh: 辭日，皇帝坐，內 殿起居班欲絕，諸司排當有備，催合侍宴臣僚東西相向，班立崇德殿庭。

translations.literal: On the farewell day the emperor was seated; the inner-hall audience formation was nearly complete; the various offices had finished their arrangements; attending banquet officials were summoned east and west facing one another and stood in formation in the courtyard of the Hall of Chongde.
translations.idiomatic: On the farewell day the emperor took his seat; the inner-hall audience formation was nearly complete; the various offices had finished their arrangements; attending banquet officials were summoned to stand facing one another east and west in the courtyard of the Hall of Chongde.

sentences.zh: 俟奏班齊，舍人喝拜，東西班殿侍兩拜，奏聖躬萬福，喝各祗候。

translations.literal: When it was reported that the formations were complete, the Protocol Gentleman shouted to bow; east and west formation palace attendants bowed twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, and were shouted for each to attend.
translations.idiomatic: When it was reported that the formations were complete, the Protocol Gentleman commanded a bow; east and west formation palace attendants bowed twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, and were told to attend.

sentences.zh: 次舍人通館伴使副某甲以 下常起居，次通契丹使某甲常起居，次通副使某甲常起居，俱引赴西面立。

translations.literal: Next the Protocol Gentleman announced the host envoys So-and-so and those below for the regular audience bow; next announced the Khitan envoy So-and-so for the regular audience bow; next announced the deputy envoy So-and-so for the regular audience bow; all were led to stand on the west side.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Protocol Gentleman announced the host envoys So-and-so and those below for the regular audience bow; then the Khitan envoy So-and-so; then the deputy envoy So-and-so; all were led to stand on the west side.

sentences.zh: 次通宰臣以下橫行，通某甲以下，應喏，奏聖躬萬福，喝各就坐，應喏，兩拜呼萬歲，分 升殿東西向立。

translations.literal: Next prime ministers and those below were announced in transverse passage; So-and-so and those below were announced; they responded to the command, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, were shouted to each take seat, responded to the command, bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, and separately ascended the hall standing east and west.
translations.idiomatic: Next prime ministers and those below were announced in transverse passage; So-and-so and those below responded to the command, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, were commanded to be seated, bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, and separately ascended the hall to stand east and west.

sentences.zh: 次通事、舍人引契丹舍利以下，次差來通事、從人俱分班入，當殿兩拜，奏聖躬萬福，喝各就坐，兩拜，呼萬歲，分引赴兩廊立。

translations.literal: Next the interpreter and Protocol Gentleman led Khitan Shili and those below; next led envoys sent on assignment and attendants, all entering in divided formations; before the hall they bowed twice, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, were shouted to each take seat, bowed twice, shouted ten thousand years, and were separately led to stand in the two corridors.
translations.idiomatic: Next the interpreter and Protocol Gentleman led Khitan Shili and those below, then assigned envoys and attendants; all entered in divided formations, bowed twice before the hall, reported the Sage's Body in ten thousand blessings, were seated, bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, and were led to stand in the two corridors.

sentences.zh: 次通教坊使、看 盞。

translations.literal: Next the Director of the Music Bureau and cup-watchers were announced.
translations.idiomatic: Next the Director of the Music Bureau and the cup-watchers were announced.

sentences.zh: 及進茶床、酹酒並閣門奏進酒，並如長春宴日之儀。

translations.literal: Advancing the tea couch, pouring the libation, and the Gate Office reporting presentation of wine—all followed the protocol of the Everlasting Spring banquet day.
translations.idiomatic: The advancing of the tea couch, the libation, and the Gate Office report of wine presentation all followed the Everlasting Spring banquet protocol.

sentences.zh: 酒五巡，起。

translations.literal: After five rounds of wine they rose.
translations.idiomatic: After five rounds of wine the banquet rose.

sentences.zh: 宰臣以下降階班立，兩拜、搢笏、舞蹈，三拜，喝各祗候。

translations.literal: Prime ministers and those below descended the steps and stood in formation, bowed twice, inserted tablets, danced, bowed three times, and were shouted for each to attend.
translations.idiomatic: Prime ministers and those below left the steps and stood in formation, bowed twice, inserted their tablets, danced, bowed three times, and were told to attend.

sentences.zh: 宰臣以下並三司使、文明殿學士、 樞密直學士升殿侍立，其餘臣僚並契丹使並出。

translations.literal: Prime ministers and those below together with commissioners of the three departments, Academicians of the Hall of Civil Splendor, and Academicians Ex Officio of the Privy Council ascended the hall to attend standing; the remaining officials together with the Khitan envoys all exited.
translations.idiomatic: Prime ministers, commissioners of the three departments, Academicians of the Hall of Civil Splendor, and Academicians Ex Officio of the Privy Council ascended to attend in the hall; all other officials and the Khitan envoys exited.

sentences.zh: 次引舍利及差來從人，俱兩拜萬歲訖，分班引出。

translations.literal: Next Shili and envoys sent on assignment and attendants were led; all bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years and finished, and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: Next Shili, assigned envoys, and attendants were led out; all bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, then exited in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 如傳宣賜茶酒，更喝謝拜如前儀。

translations.literal: If an edict was transmitted granting tea and wine, again shouted the thanks bow as in the protocol above.
translations.idiomatic: If tea and wine were granted by edict, the thanks bow was again commanded as before.

sentences.zh: 已上班絕，舍人再引契丹使入， 西面揖躬。

translations.literal: When the formations in the hall were complete, the Protocol Gentleman again led the Khitan envoy in; he bowed with joined hands to the west.
translations.idiomatic: When the hall formations were complete, the Protocol Gentleman again led the Khitan envoy in to bow with joined hands toward the west.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿通北朝國信使某祗候辭，通訖，引當殿兩拜，出班致辭，歸位，又兩拜訖，宣有敕賜，跪受拜舞訖，喝好去，遂引出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman before the hall announced the credentialed envoy of the Northern Court So-and-so attending to take leave; when the announcement was finished, he was led before the hall to bow twice, stepped from the formation to deliver his farewell address, returned to place, again bowed twice and finished; an edict grant was proclaimed; he knelt to receive, bowed and danced and finished, was shouted "Fare well," and was led out.
translations.idiomatic: Before the hall the Protocol Gentleman announced the Northern Court credentialed envoy So-and-so attending to take leave; when announced, he was led to bow twice before the hall, stepped forward to deliver his farewell, returned, bowed twice again; an edict grant was proclaimed; he knelt, received, bowed and danced; was told "Fare well," and was led out.

sentences.zh: 次引副使致詞、受賜、拜 舞如前儀，亦出。

translations.literal: Next the deputy envoy was led to deliver his address, receive the grant, and bow and dance as in the protocol above; he too exited.
translations.idiomatic: Next the deputy envoy delivered his address, received the grant, and bowed and danced as before; he too exited.

sentences.zh: 次引舍利已下，次引差來通事、從人，俱分班入，舍人喝有敕賜衣服、衣著、銀器分物，各應喏跪受，候抬擔床絕，就拜，起，又兩拜萬歲，喝好 去，分班引出。

translations.literal: Next Shili and those below were led; next assigned envoys and attendants were led; all entered in divided formations; the Protocol Gentleman shouted that there was an edict granting robes, clothing, and divided silverware; each responded to the command, knelt to receive; when the carrying couch was withdrawn they bowed in place, rose, again bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, were shouted "Fare well," and were led out in divided formations.
translations.idiomatic: Next Shili and those below, then assigned envoys and attendants, all entered in divided formations; the Protocol Gentleman announced an edict granting robes, clothing, and divided silverware; each responded, knelt to receive; when the carrying couch was withdrawn they bowed, rose, bowed twice and shouted ten thousand years, were told "Fare well," and exited in divided formations.

sentences.zh: 其使副各服所賜，再引入，當殿兩拜萬歲訖，喝祗候，引升殿，當御前立。

translations.literal: The deputy envoys each wore what had been granted, were led in again, bowed twice before the hall and shouted ten thousand years and finished, were shouted to attend, were led up to the hall, and stood before the emperor.
translations.idiomatic: Each deputy envoy wore what had been granted, was led in again, bowed twice before the hall and shouted ten thousand years, was told to attend, was led up the hall, and stood before the emperor.

sentences.zh: 皇帝宣閣門使授旨傳語國主，舍人揖國信使跪，閣門使傳旨通譯訖，揖國 信使起立，閣門使御前搢笏，於內侍都知處奉授書匣，舍人揖國信使跪，閣門使跪分付訖，揖起下殿，西出。

translations.literal: The emperor proclaimed that the Gate Commissioner should convey the edict and speak to the ruler; the Protocol Gentleman gestured for the credentialed envoy to kneel; the Gate Commissioner conveyed the edict and the translation was finished; he gestured for the credentialed envoy to rise; the Gate Commissioner before the emperor inserted his tablet, received the document casket from the Chief Palace Attendant, the Protocol Gentleman gestured for the credentialed envoy to kneel, the Gate Commissioner knelt and handed it over and finished, gestured to rise, descended from the hall, and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the Gate Commissioner to convey the edict to the Khitan ruler; the Protocol Gentleman signaled the credentialed envoy to kneel; the Gate Commissioner conveyed the edict through the interpreter; the envoy rose; the Gate Commissioner inserted his tablet before the emperor, received the document casket from the Chief Palace Attendant, the envoy knelt again, the Gate Commissioner knelt and handed it over, signaled him to rise, left the hall, and exited west.

sentences.zh: 政和詳定五禮，有《紫宸殿大遼使朝見 儀》、《紫宸殿正旦宴大遼使儀》、《紫宸殿大遼使朝辭儀》、《崇政殿假日大遼使朝見儀》、《崇政殿假日大遼使朝辭儀》。

translations.literal: In the Zhenghe era the Five Rites were examined in detail, producing "Protocol for Liao Envoys at Audience in the Hall of Purple Brightness," "Protocol for the New Year's Day Banquet for Liao Envoys in the Hall of Purple Brightness," "Protocol for Liao Envoys Taking Leave at Audience in the Hall of Purple Brightness," "Protocol for Liao Envoys at Audience on a Holiday in the Hall of Chongzheng," and "Protocol for Liao Envoys Taking Leave on a Holiday in the Hall of Chongzheng."
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhenghe revision of the Five Rites there were separate protocols for Liao audiences and farewells at the Hall of Purple Brightness, for the New Year's banquet with Liao envoys there, and for Liao audiences and farewells on holidays at the Hall of Chongzheng.

sentences.zh: 其紫宸殿赴宴，遼使副位御坐西，諸 衛上將軍之南。

translations.literal: At banquets in the Hall of Purple Brightness, the Liao deputy envoys were placed west of the imperial seat, south of the various guards' senior generals.
translations.idiomatic: At Purple Brightness banquets the Liao deputy envoys sat west of the throne, south of the senior generals of the guard.

sentences.zh: 夏使副在東朵殿，並西向北上。

translations.literal: Xia deputy envoys were in the eastern side hall, all facing west and ascending from the north.
translations.idiomatic: Western Xia deputy envoys were placed in the eastern side hall, facing west and ranked from the north.

sentences.zh: 高麗、交阯使副在西朵殿，並東向北上，遼使舍利、從人各在其南。

translations.literal: Goryeo and Jiaozhi deputy envoys were in the western side hall, all facing east and ascending from the north; Liao Shili and attendants were each south of them.
translations.idiomatic: Goryeo and Jiaozhi deputy envoys were in the western side hall, facing east and ranked from the north; Liao Shili and attendants were south of each group respectively.

sentences.zh: 夏使從人在東廊舍利之南，諸蕃使副首領、高麗 交阯從人、溪峒衙內指揮使在西廊舍利之南。

translations.literal: Xia attendants were south of Shili in the eastern corridor; chiefs of various foreign deputy envoys, Goryeo and Jiaozhi attendants, and commanders of the Xi and Dong inner offices were south of Shili in the western corridor.
translations.idiomatic: Xia attendants stood south of Shili in the east corridor; chiefs of other foreign missions, Goryeo and Jiaozhi attendants, and Xi-Dong inner-office commanders stood south of Shili in the west corridor.

sentences.zh: 又至各就位，有分引兩廊班首詣御坐進酒，樂作，讚各賜酒，群官俱再拜就坐。

translations.literal: When all had reached their places, designated leaders from the two corridors were separately led to advance wine before the imperial seat; music sounded; the intoner praised each grant of wine; all officials together bowed again and took seat.
translations.idiomatic: When all were in place, corridor formation chiefs were led forward to present wine before the throne; music played; the intoner announced each grant of wine; all officials bowed again and were seated.

sentences.zh: 酒五行，皆作樂賜華，皇帝再坐，赴宴 官行謝華之禮。

translations.literal: After five rounds of wine, at each round music sounded and floral gifts were granted; the emperor sat again; banquet officials performed the rite of thanks for the floral gifts.
translations.idiomatic: For each of five rounds of wine, music played and flowers were granted; the emperor resumed his seat; attending officials performed the thanks-for-flowers rite.

sentences.zh: 夏國進奉使見辭儀。

translations.literal: Protocols for audience and farewell with envoys presenting tribute from Xia.
translations.idiomatic: Protocols for Western Xia tribute envoys at audience and farewell.

sentences.zh: 夏國歲以正旦、聖節入貢。

translations.literal: Each year Xia presented tribute on New Year's Day and the Sage's Birthday.
translations.idiomatic: The Western Xia sent tribute annually on New Year's Day and the imperial birthday.

sentences.zh: 元豐八年，使來。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yuanfeng envoys came.
translations.idiomatic: In 1085 envoys arrived.

sentences.zh: 詔夏國見辭儀製依嘉祐八年，見於皇儀殿門外，朝辭詣垂拱殿。

translations.literal: An edict ordered that Xia audience and farewell protocols follow the eighth year of Jiayou: audience outside the gate of the Hall of Imperial Rites, farewell audience at the Hall of Chui Gong.
translations.idiomatic: An edict fixed Xia audience and farewell protocols on the Jiayou (1063) precedent: audience outside the Hall of Imperial Rites, farewell at the Hall of Chui Gong.

sentences.zh: 政和新儀：夏使見日，俟見班絕、謝班前，使奉奉表，引入殿庭，副使隨入，西向立，舍人揖躬。

translations.literal: New protocols of the Zhenghe era: on the day the Xia envoy was received, after the audience formation was complete and before the thanks formation, the envoy bore the tribute memorial and was led into the hall courtyard; the deputy followed in; they stood facing west; the Protocol Gentleman bowed with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: Under the Zhenghe rites, on the Xia reception day, after the audience formation ended and before the thanks formation, the envoy bore the memorial and entered the courtyard with his deputy; they stood facing west while the Protocol Gentleman bowed.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿躬奏夏國進奉使姓名以下祗候見，引當殿前跪進表函， 舍人受之，副入內侍省官進呈。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman bowed before the hall and reported that the Xia tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attended for audience; he was led before the hall to kneel and advance the memorial casket; the Protocol Gentleman received it; the deputy followed as a palace service official of the Inner Palace Service advanced it for presentation.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman reported before the hall that the Xia tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attended for audience, led him to kneel and present the memorial; received the casket; a deputy Inner Palace Service official carried it in for presentation.

sentences.zh: 使者起，歸位，四拜起居。

translations.literal: The envoy rose, returned to place, and performed the four-bow audience.
translations.idiomatic: The envoy rose, returned to his place, and performed the four-bow audience.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣有敕賜某物，兼賜酒饌。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed that there was an edict granting certain objects, together with wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed an edict granting certain objects together with wine and provisions.

sentences.zh: 跪受，箱過，俯伏興，再拜。

translations.literal: He knelt to receive; when the box had passed he prostrated himself and rose, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: He knelt to receive; when the gift box had passed he prostrated himself, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人曰各祗候，揖西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman said for each to attend; they bowed with joined hands and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman told them to attend; they bowed and exited west.

sentences.zh: 次從人入，不奏， 即引當殿四拜起居。

translations.literal: Next the attendants entered; without announcement they were at once led before the hall for the four-bow audience.
translations.idiomatic: Next the attendants entered; without announcement they were led before the hall for the four-bow audience.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣賜分物，兼賜酒食。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed grants of divided objects, together with wine and food.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed grants of divided gifts together with wine and food.

sentences.zh: 跪受，箱過，俯伏興，再拜。

translations.literal: They knelt to receive; when the box had passed they prostrated themselves and rose, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: They knelt to receive; when the boxes had passed they prostrated themselves, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人曰各祗候，揖西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman said for each to attend; they bowed with joined hands and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman told them to attend; they bowed and exited west.

sentences.zh: 辭日，引使副入殿庭，西向立，舍人揖躬。

translations.literal: On the farewell day the envoy and deputy were led into the hall courtyard, stood facing west, and the Protocol Gentleman bowed with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: On the farewell day the envoy and deputy entered the courtyard, stood facing west, and the Protocol Gentleman bowed.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿躬奏夏國 進奉使姓名以下祗候辭，引當殿四拜。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman bowed before the hall and reported that the Xia tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attended to take leave; he was led before the hall for the four bows.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman reported that the Xia tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attended to take leave and led him before the hall for four bows.

sentences.zh: 宣賜某物酒饌，再拜如見儀。

translations.literal: An edict granted certain objects, wine, and food; he bowed again as in the audience protocol.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted objects, wine, and provisions; he bowed again as at the audience.

sentences.zh: 凡蕃使見辭，同日者，先夏國，次高麗，次交阯，次海外蕃客，次諸蠻。

translations.literal: Whenever foreign envoys had audience and farewell on the same day, the order was: Xia first, then Goryeo, then Jiaozhi, then overseas foreign guests, then the various Man peoples.
translations.idiomatic: When foreign envoys shared the same audience and farewell day, precedence ran: Western Xia, then Goryeo, then Jiaozhi, then overseas guests, then the various southern peoples.

sentences.zh: 高麗進奉 使見辭儀。

translations.literal: Protocols for audience and farewell with envoys presenting tribute from Goryeo.
translations.idiomatic: Protocols for Goryeo tribute envoys at audience and farewell.

sentences.zh: 見日，使捧表函，引入殿庭，副使隨入，西向立，舍人鞠躬，當殿前通高麗國進奉使姓名以下祗候見，引當殿，使稍前跪進表函，俯伏興訖，歸位大起 居。

translations.literal: On the audience day the envoy bore the memorial casket and was led into the hall courtyard; the deputy followed in; they stood facing west; the Protocol Gentleman bowed at the waist; before the hall he announced the Goryeo tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attending for audience; he was led before the hall; the envoy advanced slightly, knelt, and presented the memorial casket; when prostration and rising were finished he returned to place for the grand audience bow.
translations.idiomatic: On the audience day the envoy bore the memorial and entered the courtyard with his deputy; standing west, the Protocol Gentleman bowed and announced the Goryeo tribute envoy So-and-so for audience; the envoy advanced, knelt, presented the casket, rose from prostration, and returned for the grand audience bow.

sentences.zh: 班首出班躬謝起居，歸位，再拜，又出班謝麵天顏、沿路館券、都城門外茶酒，歸位，再拜，搢笏，舞蹈，俯伏興，再拜。

translations.literal: The formation chief stepped from the formation, bowed at the waist, and thanked him for the audience bow; returned to place and bowed again; again stepped from the formation to thank him for viewing the heavenly countenance, for relay-station vouchers and tea and wine outside the capital gate, returned to place, bowed again, inserted tablet, danced, prostrated himself and rose, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The formation chief stepped forward to thank him for the audience, returned and bowed again, stepped forward to thank him for viewing the heavenly countenance, for relay provisions and capital gate tea and wine, returned, bowed again, inserted his tablet, danced, prostrated himself, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣有敕賜某物兼賜酒食，搢笏， 跪受，箱過，俯伏興，再拜。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed that there was an edict granting certain objects together with wine and food; he inserted his tablet, knelt to receive; when the box had passed he prostrated himself and rose, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed an edict granting certain objects and wine and food; he inserted his tablet, knelt to receive, prostrated himself when the box had passed, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人曰各祗候，揖西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman said for each to attend; they bowed with joined hands and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman told them to attend; they bowed and exited west.

sentences.zh: 次押物以下入，不通，即引當殿四拜起居。

translations.literal: Next those in charge of tribute objects and those below entered; without announcement they were at once led before the hall for the four-bow audience.
translations.idiomatic: Next tribute officers and those below entered; without announcement they performed the four-bow audience before the hall.

sentences.zh: 宣有敕賜某物兼賜酒食，跪受，箱過，俯伏興，再拜起居。

translations.literal: An edict was proclaimed granting certain objects together with wine and food; he knelt to receive; when the box had passed he prostrated himself and rose, and bowed again for the audience.
translations.idiomatic: An edict granted certain objects and wine and food; he knelt to receive, prostrated himself when the box had passed, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人曰 各祗候，揖西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman said for each to attend; they bowed with joined hands and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman told them to attend; they bowed and exited west.

sentences.zh: 辭日，引使副入殿庭，西向立，舍人揖躬。

translations.literal: On the farewell day the envoy and deputy were led into the hall courtyard, stood facing west, and the Protocol Gentleman bowed with joined hands.
translations.idiomatic: On the farewell day the envoy and deputy entered the courtyard, stood west, and the Protocol Gentleman bowed.

sentences.zh: 舍人當殿躬通高麗進奉使姓名以下祗候辭，引當殿四拜起居。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman bowed before the hall and announced the Goryeo tribute envoy So-and-so and those below attending to take leave; he was led before the hall for the four-bow audience.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman announced the Goryeo tribute envoy So-and-so for farewell and led him before the hall for the four-bow audience.

sentences.zh: 班首出、班致詞，歸位，再拜。

translations.literal: The formation chief stepped out and delivered the farewell address from the formation; returned to place and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The formation chief stepped forward to deliver the farewell address, returned, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人宣有敕賜某物兼賜酒食，搢笏，跪受，箱過，俯伏興，再拜。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed that there was an edict granting certain objects together with wine and food; he inserted his tablet, knelt to receive; when the box had passed he prostrated himself and rose, and bowed again.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman proclaimed an edict granting objects and wine and food; he inserted his tablet, knelt, prostrated himself when the box had passed, rose, and bowed again.

sentences.zh: 舍人曰好去，揖西出。

translations.literal: The Protocol Gentleman said "Fare well"; they bowed with joined hands and exited to the west.
translations.idiomatic: The Protocol Gentleman said "Fare well"; they bowed and exited west.

sentences.zh: 次從人入辭，如見。

translations.literal: Next the attendants entered to take leave, as at the audience.
translations.idiomatic: Next the attendants entered to take leave, following the audience protocol.

sentences.zh: 政和元年，詔高麗在西北二國之間，自今可依熙寧十年指揮隸樞密院。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhenghe an edict stated that Goryeo lay between the two northwestern states; from this time it was to follow the Xining tenth-year directive and be placed under the Privy Council.
translations.idiomatic: In 1111 an edict noted that Goryeo lay between the Khitan and Xia domains and ordered that, henceforth, it follow the 1077 directive and be administered through the Privy Council.

sentences.zh: 明年入貢，詔復用熙寧例，以文臣充接伴使副，仍往還許上殿。

translations.literal: The next year when tribute was presented, an edict restored the Xining precedent of appointing civil officials as host envoys, who were still permitted to ascend the hall on the outbound and return journeys.
translations.idiomatic: The following year, when tribute arrived, the court restored the Xining practice of civil host envoys, who might still ascend the hall on their journeys to and from court.

sentences.zh: 七年，賜以籩豆各十二，簠 簋各四，登一，鉶二，鼎二，罍洗一，尊二。

translations.literal: In the seventh year there were granted twelve platters and twelve stands each, four grain vessels and four tureens each, one pedestal vessel, two offering stands, two tripods, one wash vessel and wine jar, and two wine vessels.
translations.idiomatic: In 1117 the court granted twelve platters and twelve stands, four grain vessels and four tureens, one pedestal vessel, two offering stands, two tripods, one wash set, and two wine vessels.

sentences.zh: 銘曰：“惟爾令德孝恭，世稱東蕃，有來顯相，予一人嘉之。

translations.literal: The inscription read: "Your virtuous and filial conduct is renowned; the world calls you the eastern tributary; you have come to serve as our eminent minister, and I alone commend you.
translations.idiomatic: The inscription read: "For your virtuous and filial conduct, renowned throughout the world as the eastern tributary, you have come to serve at court as our eminent minister, and I commend you alone.

sentences.zh: 用錫爾寶尊，以寧爾祖考。

translations.literal: We bestow upon you treasured wine vessels to bring peace to your ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: I bestow upon you these ritual vessels that your ancestors may rest in peace.

sentences.zh: 子子孫孫，其永保之！

translations.literal: Sons and grandsons—may they preserve them forever!"
translations.idiomatic: May sons and grandsons preserve them forever!"

sentences.zh: ”紹興 二年，高麗遣使副來貢，並賜酒食於同文館。

translations.literal: " In the second year of Shaoxing Goryeo sent deputy envoys to present tribute, and wine and food were granted at the Lodge of Shared Texts.
translations.idiomatic: In 1132 Goryeo sent deputy envoys with tribute, and wine and food were granted at the Lodge of Shared Texts.

sentences.zh: 金國聘使見辭儀。

translations.literal: Protocols for audience and farewell with envoys on mission from the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: Protocols for Jin envoys at audience and farewell.

sentences.zh: 宣和元年，金使李善慶等來，遣直秘閣趙有開偕善慶等報聘。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuanhe Jin envoys Li Shanching and others came; the Direct Gentleman of the Secretariat Zhao Youkai was dispatched together with Shanching and others on a return mission.
translations.idiomatic: In 1119 Jin envoys led by Li Shanching arrived; Zhao Youkai, Direct Gentleman of the Secretariat, was sent with them on the return embassy.

sentences.zh: 已而金使復至，用新羅使人禮，引見宣政殿，徽宗臨軒受使者書。

translations.literal: Before long Jin envoys came again; the protocol for Silla envoys was used; they were led to audience in the Hall of Xuanzheng; Emperor Huizong received the envoys' letter from the throne.
translations.idiomatic: Soon Jin envoys came again; Silla envoy protocol was applied; they were received at the Hall of Xuanzheng, where Emperor Huizong accepted their letter from the throne.

sentences.zh: 自後屢遣使來，帝待之甚厚，時引上殿奏事，賜予不貲，禮遇並用契丹故事。

translations.literal: Thereafter envoys were repeatedly dispatched; the emperor treated them very generously, often summoning them up to the hall to report affairs; grants were beyond counting; courtesies altogether followed Khitan precedent.
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Jin envoys came repeatedly; the emperor treated them with exceptional generosity, often summoning them to the hall to report, with lavish grants and courtesies modeled on Khitan precedent.

sentences.zh: 紹興三年十二月，宰臣進呈金使李永壽等正旦入見。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the third year of Shaoxing the chief ministers presented Jin envoys Li Yongshou and others for the New Year audience.
translations.idiomatic: In December 1133 the chief ministers presented Jin envoys led by Li Yongshou for the New Year audience.

sentences.zh: 故事，百官俱入。

translations.literal: By precedent all officials entered together.
translations.idiomatic: By precedent all officials entered together.

sentences.zh: 上曰：“全盛之時，神京會同，朝廷之尊，百官之富，所以誇示。

translations.literal: The emperor said: "In times of full prosperity the divine capital gathered all under heaven; the court's majesty and the officials' wealth were what we displayed to impress.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "In our days of full prosperity the divine capital gathered all under heaven, and the court's majesty and the wealth of its officials were displayed to impress.

sentences.zh: 今暫駐於此。

translations.literal: Now we are temporarily lodged here.
translations.idiomatic: Now we are lodged here only for a time.

sentences.zh: 事從簡便。

translations.literal: Matters should be kept simple.
translations.idiomatic: Affairs should be kept simple.

sentences.zh: 舊日禮數，豈可盡行？

translations.literal: How can the old ceremonial numbers all be carried out?
translations.idiomatic: How can every detail of the old ceremonial be observed?

sentences.zh: 無庸俱入。

translations.literal: There is no need for all to enter.
translations.idiomatic: There is no need for everyone to enter.

sentences.zh: ”使人見辭，並賜食於殿門外。

translations.literal: " Envoys at audience and farewell were both granted food outside the hall gate.
translations.idiomatic: The envoys were granted food outside the hall gate at both audience and farewell.

sentences.zh: 八年，金國遣使副來，就驛議和。

translations.literal: In the eighth year deputy envoys from the Jin state came to negotiate peace at the relay station.
translations.idiomatic: In 1138 Jin deputy envoys came to negotiate peace at the embassy station.

sentences.zh: 詔王倫就驛賜宴。

translations.literal: An edict ordered Wang Lun to grant a banquet at the relay station.
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered Wang Lun to host a banquet for them at the station.

sentences.zh: 十一年十一月，金國遣審議使來。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the eleventh year envoys on a review mission came from the Jin state.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1141 Jin envoys on a review mission arrived.

sentences.zh: 入見，時殿 陛之儀議猶未決。

translations.literal: At audience, debate over protocol for the hall steps was still unresolved.
translations.idiomatic: At their audience, debate over protocol at the hall steps was still unresolved.

sentences.zh: 議者謂“兵衛單弱，則非所以隆國體；

translations.literal: Some argued, "If the guard is too thin, that is not how to elevate the state's dignity;
translations.idiomatic: Some argued that "if the guard were too thin, the state's dignity would not be elevated;

sentences.zh: 欲設仗衛，恐駭虜情。

translations.literal: yet if armed escort is set out, we fear alarming the envoys' feelings."
translations.idiomatic: yet if full armed escort were deployed, the envoys might be alarmed."

sentences.zh: ”乃設黃麾仗千五百人於殿廊，蔽以帟幕，班定徹帷。

translations.literal: " Thereupon fifteen hundred yellow-banner guards were stationed in the hall corridors, screened by curtains; when the formations were set the curtains were drawn aside.
translations.idiomatic: They therefore stationed fifteen hundred yellow-banner guards in the hall corridors behind curtains; when formations were complete the curtains were withdrawn.

sentences.zh: 十二年，扈從徽宗梓宮、皇太 後使副來。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year envoys escorting Emperor Huizong's coffin and the empress dowager came.
translations.idiomatic: In 1142 envoys escorting Emperor Huizong's coffin and the empress dowager arrived.

sentences.zh: 十三年十一月，有司言：“賀正旦使初至，於盱眙軍賜宴。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the thirteenth year the relevant offices reported: "When envoys congratulating on New Year's Day first arrive, a banquet is granted at Xuyi Army.
translations.idiomatic: In November 1143 the relevant offices reported: "When New Year congratulatory envoys first arrive, a banquet is granted at Xuyi.

sentences.zh: 未審回程合與不合筵待？

translations.literal: It is not yet clear whether on the return journey a banquet should again be granted?"
translations.idiomatic: It is unclear whether a banquet should again be granted on the return journey."

sentences.zh: ”詔內侍省差使臣二員沿路賜禦筵，一員於平江府，一員於鎮江府， 一員於盱眙軍。

translations.literal: An edict ordered the Inner Service Bureau to dispatch two envoys to grant imperial banquets along the route—one at Pingjiang Prefecture, one at Zhenjiang Prefecture, and one at Xuyi Army—
translations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the Inner Service Bureau to dispatch two envoys to grant imperial banquets along the route—one at Pingjiang, one at Zhenjiang, and one at Xuyi—

sentences.zh: 尋詔：金國賀正旦人使到闕赴宴等坐次，令與宰臣相對稍南。

translations.literal: Shortly thereafter an edict ordered: for seating at banquets and the like when Jin New Year congratulatory envoys reached the capital, they were to face the chief ministers opposite, slightly to the south—
translations.idiomatic: An edict soon followed: when Jin New Year congratulatory envoys reached the capital for banquets and similar occasions, their seats were to face the chief ministers opposite, slightly to the south—

sentences.zh: 使副上下馬於執政官上下馬處。

translations.literal: The envoy and his deputy mounted and dismounted at the mounting place of executive officials—
translations.idiomatic: The chief envoy and his deputy mounted and dismounted where executive officials did—

sentences.zh: 三節人從並於宮門外上下馬。

translations.literal: All personnel of the three sections likewise mounted and dismounted outside the palace gate—
translations.idiomatic: Personnel of all three ranks likewise mounted and dismounted outside the palace gate—

sentences.zh: 立班則於西班，與宰臣相 對立。

translations.literal: For standing in formation they stood in the western formation, facing the chief ministers opposite—
translations.idiomatic: When standing in formation they took the western line, facing the chief ministers opposite—

sentences.zh: 仍權移西班使相在東壁宰臣之東。

translations.literal: Moreover, provisionally the western-formation commissioners were shifted to the east of the chief ministers on the east wall—
translations.idiomatic: The western-line commissioners were also provisionally moved to stand east of the chief ministers on the east wall—

sentences.zh: 十四年正月一日，宴金國人使於紫宸殿。

translations.literal: On the first day of the first month of the fourteenth year a banquet for Jin envoys was held in the Hall of Purple Felicity—
translations.idiomatic: On the first day of the first month in 1144 the court banqueted Jin envoys in the Hall of Purple Felicity—

sentences.zh: 文臣權侍郎已上、武臣刺史已上赴坐。

translations.literal: Civil officials of acting vice-minister rank and above and military officials of prefect rank and above attended seating—
translations.idiomatic: Civil officials from acting vice-minister upward and military officials from prefect upward attended—

sentences.zh: 自後正旦賜宴仿此。

translations.literal: Thereafter New Year banquets followed this model—
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter New Year banquets followed this precedent—

sentences.zh: 五月，金國始遣賀天申 節使來。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the Jin state for the first time dispatched envoys congratulating on the Heavenly Succession Festival—
translations.idiomatic: In May the Jin for the first time sent envoys to congratulate the Heavenly Succession Festival—

sentences.zh: 有司言合照舊例：北使賀生辰聖節使副隨宰臣紫宸殿上壽，進壽酒畢，皇帝、宰臣以下同使副酒三行，教坊作樂，三節人從不赴。

translations.literal: The relevant offices stated that according to old precedent: when northern envoys congratulated on the birth-day sacred festival, the envoy and deputy followed the chief ministers to offer longevity in the Hall of Purple Felicity; when the longevity wine was presented, the emperor and chief ministers below shared three rounds of wine with the envoy and deputy, the Music Bureau performed, and personnel of the three sections did not attend—
translations.idiomatic: The relevant offices cited old precedent: when northern envoys came for the imperial birthday, the chief envoy and deputy followed the chief ministers to offer longevity rites in the Hall of Purple Felicity; after the longevity wine was presented, the emperor and officials below shared three rounds with them while the Music Bureau performed, but personnel of the three ranks did not attend—

sentences.zh: 既而三節人從有請，乞隨 班上壽，詔許之，仍賜酒食。

translations.literal: Thereafter personnel of the three sections petitioned, begging to follow the formation to offer longevity; an edict permitted it, and wine and food were still granted—
translations.idiomatic: The three ranks' personnel then petitioned to join the formation for the longevity rite; the court permitted this and granted them wine and food—

sentences.zh: 遇賀正，人使朝辭在上辛祠官致齋之內，仍用樂。

translations.literal: When congratulating on the New Year, at the envoy's farewell audience, if it fell within the fasting period of the upper-ren offering officer, music was still used—
translations.idiomatic: For New Year envoys, at the farewell audience, if it fell within the upper-ren offering officer's fasting period, music was still performed—

sentences.zh: 二十九年，以皇太后崩，其賀正使副止就驛賜宴。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year, because the empress dowager had died, the New Year envoys and deputy were granted banquets only at the relay station—
translations.idiomatic: In 1159, because the empress dowager had died, New Year envoys were banqueted only at the embassy station—

sentences.zh: 見辭日，賜茶酒，並不舉樂。

translations.literal: On the day of audience and farewell, tea and wine were granted, and music was not performed—
translations.idiomatic: On audience and farewell days they received tea and wine, but no music was performed—

sentences.zh: 大率北使至闕，先遣伴使賜禦筵於班荊館

translations.literal: In general when northern envoys reached the capital, escort envoys were first dispatched to grant imperial banquets at the Lodge of Parting from the Thorn
translations.idiomatic: In general when northern envoys reached the capital, escort envoys were first sent to host an imperial banquet at the Lodge of Parting from the Thorn

sentences.zh: （在赤岸，去府五十里）〉

translations.literal: (located at Chian, fifty li from the prefectural seat)
translations.idiomatic: (at Chian, fifty li from the prefectural seat)

sentences.zh: ，酒七行。

translations.literal: , with seven rounds of wine—
translations.idiomatic: , with seven rounds of wine—

sentences.zh: 翌日登舟，至北郭稅亭，茶酒畢，上馬入餘杭門，至都亭驛，賜褥被、钅沙鑼等。

translations.literal: The next day they boarded boats, reached the North Suburb Tax Pavilion; when tea and wine were finished they mounted and entered through Yuhang Gate, reached the Capital Pavilion relay station, and were granted mattresses, quilts, cymbals, and the like—
translations.idiomatic: The next day they boarded and reached the North Suburb Tax Pavilion; after tea and wine they mounted and entered through Yuhang Gate to the Capital Pavilion station, where they received mattresses, quilts, cymbals, and the like—

sentences.zh: 明 日，臨安府書送酒食，閣門官入位，具朝見儀，投朝見榜子。

translations.literal: The next day Lin'an Prefecture sent written notice delivering wine and food; Gate Office officials took their places, prepared the audience ceremony, and submitted the audience placard—
translations.idiomatic: The following day Lin'an Prefecture delivered wine and food in writing; Gate officials took their places, prepared the audience ceremony, and submitted the audience placard—

sentences.zh: 又明日，入見。

translations.literal: Again the next day, they had audience—
translations.idiomatic: The day after, they had audience—

sentences.zh: 伴使至南宮門外下馬，北使至隔門內下馬。

translations.literal: Escort envoys dismounted outside the Southern Palace Gate; northern envoys dismounted inside the dividing gate—
translations.idiomatic: Escorts dismounted outside the Southern Palace Gate; northern envoys dismounted inside the inner dividing gate—

sentences.zh: 皇帝御紫宸殿，六參官起居。

translations.literal: The emperor held court in the Hall of Purple Felicity; officials of the six audiences made their greetings—
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held court in the Hall of Purple Felicity as officials of the six audiences made their greetings—

sentences.zh: 北使見畢，退 赴客省茶酒，遂宴垂拱殿，酒五行，惟從官已上預坐。

translations.literal: When the northern envoy's audience was finished, he withdrew to receive tea and wine at the Guest Bureau, then was banqueted in the Hall of Sagely Accord; five rounds of wine; only attendant officials of rank and above were seated in advance—
translations.idiomatic: After audience the northern envoys withdrew for tea and wine at the Guest Bureau, then were banqueted in the Hall of Sagely Accord with five rounds of wine; only attendant officials of rank and above were seated—

sentences.zh: 是日，賜茶器名果。

translations.literal: That day tea vessels and famous fruits were granted—
translations.idiomatic: That day they received fine tea vessels and fruits—

sentences.zh: 又明日，賜生餼。

translations.literal: Again the next day, fresh provisions were granted—
translations.idiomatic: The next day they received fresh provisions—

sentences.zh: 見之二日，與伴使偕往天竺燒香，上賜沉香、乳糖、齋筵、酒果。

translations.literal: On the second day after audience, together with escort envoys they went to Tianzhu to burn incense; the emperor granted agarwood, milk sugar, vegetarian banquet provisions, and wine and fruits—
translations.idiomatic: Two days after audience they went with their escorts to burn incense at Tianzhu; the emperor granted agarwood, milk sugar, a vegetarian banquet, and wine and fruit—

sentences.zh: 次至 冷泉亭、呼猿洞而歸。

translations.literal: Next they went to Cold Spring Pavilion and Calling-Apes Cave and returned—
translations.idiomatic: They next visited Cold Spring Pavilion and Calling-Apes Cave before returning—

sentences.zh: 翌日，賜內中酒果、風藥、花餳，赴守歲夜筵，酒五行，用傀儡。

translations.literal: The next day palace wine and fruits, wind medicines, and flower candy were granted; they attended the New Year's Eve night banquet—five rounds of wine, with puppet performances—
translations.idiomatic: The next day they received palace wine and fruit, medicinal aromatics, and flower candy, then attended the New Year's Eve banquet with five rounds of wine and puppet performances—

sentences.zh: 正月朔旦，朝賀禮畢，上遣大臣就驛賜禦筵。

translations.literal: On the first morning of the first month, when the congratulatory audience rites were finished, the emperor dispatched a high minister to the relay station to grant an imperial banquet—
translations.idiomatic: On New Year's morning, after the congratulatory rites, the emperor sent a senior minister to grant an imperial banquet at the station—

sentences.zh: 中使傳旨宣勸，酒九行。

translations.literal: Palace envoys transmitted the imperial message and proclaimed encouragement; nine rounds of wine—
translations.idiomatic: Palace envoys conveyed the imperial message and urged the toasts; nine rounds of wine were served—

sentences.zh: 三 日，客省簽賜酒食，內中賜酒果。

translations.literal: On the third day the Guest Bureau countersigned and granted wine and food; the inner palace granted wine and fruits—
translations.idiomatic: On the third day the Guest Bureau granted wine and food by countersign, and the inner palace sent wine and fruit—

sentences.zh: 遂赴浙江亭觀潮，酒七行。

translations.literal: Thereupon they went to Zhejiang Pavilion to view the tide—seven rounds of wine—
translations.idiomatic: They then went to Zhejiang Pavilion to watch the tide, with seven rounds of wine—

sentences.zh: 四日，赴玉津園燕射，命諸校善射者假管軍觀察使伴之，上賜弓矢。

translations.literal: On the fourth day they went to Jade Ford Garden for a banquet and archery; various masters skilled at shooting were ordered to serve provisionally as army-supervising observers to accompany them; the emperor granted bows and arrows—
translations.idiomatic: On the fourth day they went to Jade Ford Garden for archery; skilled marksmen were appointed provisional army observers to accompany them, and the emperor granted bows and arrows—

sentences.zh: 酒行樂作，伴射官與大使並射弓， 館伴、副使並射弩。

translations.literal: As wine was served music was performed; the accompanying archery officer and the chief envoy both shot with bows; the hostel escort and deputy envoy both shot with crossbows—
translations.idiomatic: As wine was served and music played, the accompanying archer and chief envoy shot with bows while the hostel escort and deputy shot with crossbows—

sentences.zh: 酒九行，退。

translations.literal: Nine rounds of wine, then withdrawal—
translations.idiomatic: After nine rounds they withdrew—

sentences.zh: 五日，大宴集英殿，尚書郎、監察御史已上皆預，學士撰致語。

translations.literal: On the fifth day a grand banquet was held in the Hall of Assembled Eminence; Secretariat Gentlemen, investigating censors, and those of rank and above all attended; academicians composed the congratulatory address—
translations.idiomatic: On the fifth day a grand banquet was held in the Hall of Assembled Eminence; Gentlemen of the Secretariat, investigating censors, and officials of that rank and above all attended, with academicians composing the congratulatory address—

sentences.zh: 六日，朝辭退，賜襲衣、金帶、大銀器。

translations.literal: On the sixth day after the farewell audience they withdrew; robes, gold belts, and large silver vessels were granted—
translations.idiomatic: On the sixth day after their farewell audience they withdrew, granted robes, gold belts, and large silver vessels—

sentences.zh: 臨安府書送贐儀。

translations.literal: Lin'an Prefecture sent written notice delivering parting gifts—
translations.idiomatic: Lin'an Prefecture delivered parting gifts in writing—

sentences.zh: 復遣執 政官就驛賜宴。

translations.literal: Again an executive official was dispatched to the relay station to grant a banquet—
translations.idiomatic: An executive official was again sent to the station to host a banquet—

sentences.zh: 晚赴解換夜筵，伴使與北使皆親勸酬，且以衣物為侑。

translations.literal: In the evening they attended the exchange-release night banquet; escort envoys and northern envoys all personally urged rounds of toasts, and also used garments as secondary gifts—
translations.idiomatic: That evening they attended the exchange banquet; escorts and northern envoys personally urged each other's cups and also offered garments as secondary gifts—

sentences.zh: 次日，加賜龍鳳茶、金鍍合。

translations.literal: The next day additional grants of dragon-phoenix tea and gold-plated cases were made—
translations.idiomatic: The next day they received additional dragon-phoenix tea and gold-plated cases—

sentences.zh: 乘馬出北闕門登舟，宿赤岸。

translations.literal: They mounted horses, went out through the North Watchtower Gate, boarded boats, and lodged at Chian—
translations.idiomatic: They rode out through the North Watchtower Gate, boarded boats, and lodged at Chian—

sentences.zh: 又次日，復遣近臣押賜禦筵。

translations.literal: Again the next day a close minister was again dispatched to supervise the granting of an imperial banquet—
translations.idiomatic: The following day a close minister was again sent to oversee an imperial banquet—

sentences.zh: 自到闕朝見、燕射、朝辭，共賜大使金千四百兩，副使金八百八十兩，衣各三襲，金帶各三條。

translations.literal: From arrival at court through audience, banquet archery, and farewell audience, altogether granted to the chief envoy one thousand four hundred taels of gold, to the deputy eight hundred eighty taels of gold, to each three sets of robes, and to each three gold belts—
translations.idiomatic: From arrival through audience, archery banquet, and farewell, the chief envoy received fourteen hundred taels of gold, the deputy eight hundred eighty, each three sets of robes and three gold belts—

sentences.zh: 都管上節各賜銀四十兩，中下節各三十兩，衣一襲、塗金帶一條。

translations.literal: Those in charge of the upper rank of each section were each granted forty taels of silver; those of middle and lower rank thirty taels each; one set of robes and one gilded belt each—
translations.idiomatic: Supervisors of the upper rank in each section received forty taels of silver each; middle and lower ranks thirty taels each, plus one set of robes and one gilded belt—

sentences.zh: 使人到闕筵宴，凡用樂人三百人，百戲軍七十人，築球軍三十二人，起立球門行人三十二人，旗鼓四十人，並下臨安府差；

translations.literal: For banquets when envoys reached the capital, in all three hundred musicians were used, seventy men of the variety-troop corps, thirty-two men of the cuju corps, thirty-two ball-goal attendants, forty banner-drummers—all dispatched by Lin'an Prefecture;
translations.idiomatic: For envoys' banquets at court, three hundred musicians, seventy variety-troop performers, thirty-two cuju players, thirty-two ball-goal attendants, and forty banner-drummers were all dispatched by Lin'an Prefecture;

sentences.zh: 相撲一十五人，於御前等子內差，並前期 教習之。

translations.literal: fifteen sumo wrestlers, selected from within the imperial front wrestling roster, all drilled in advance—
translations.idiomatic: Fifteen sumo wrestlers were selected from the imperial front roster and drilled in advance—

sentences.zh: 諸國朝貢，其交州、宜州、黎州諸國見辭，並如上儀。

translations.literal: For tribute missions from the various states, when envoys from Jiaozhi, Yizhou, Lizhou, and the like had audience and farewell, all followed the ceremony above—
translations.idiomatic: For tribute from various states, audiences and farewells from Jiaozhi, Yizhou, Lizhou, and the like all followed the ceremony above—

sentences.zh: 惟迓勞宴賚之數，則有殺焉。

translations.literal: Only in the numbers for welcoming, laboring, banqueting, and bestowing gifts were there reductions—
translations.idiomatic: Only the scale of welcoming, entertainment, banquet, and gifts was reduced—

sentences.zh: 其授書皆令有司付之。

translations.literal: Presentation of credentials was all ordered to be handled by the relevant offices—
translations.idiomatic: Credential presentation was entrusted to the relevant offices—

sentences.zh: 又有西蕃唃氏、西南諸蕃占城、回 鶻、大食、於闐、三佛齊、邛部川蠻及溪峒之屬，或比間數歲入貢。

translations.literal: There were also the Western Tibetan Gu clan, the various southwestern peoples of Champa, Uyghurs, Arabs, Khotan, Srivijaya, the Qiongbu River barbarians, and creek-gorge peoples—some of whom presented tribute every few years at intervals—
translations.idiomatic: There were also the Western Tibetan Gu clan, southwestern peoples including Champa, Uyghurs, Arabs, Khotan, Srivijaya, the Qiongbu River tribes, and creek-gorge peoples, some of whom presented tribute every few years—

sentences.zh: 層檀、日本、大理、注輦、蒲甘、龜茲、佛泥、拂菻、真臘、羅殿、渤泥、邈黎、闍婆、甘眉流 諸國入貢，或一再，或三四，不常至。

translations.literal: States such as Zantan, Japan, Dali, Chola, Pagan, Kucha, Funan, Farang, Chenla, Luodian, Brunei, Moli, Java, and Gan Meiliu presented tribute once or twice, or three or four times, and did not come regularly—
translations.idiomatic: States including Zantan, Japan, Dali, Chola, Pagan, Kucha, Funan, Farang, Chenla, Luodian, Brunei, Moli, Java, and Gan Meiliu sent tribute once or twice, or three or four times, but not on a fixed schedule—

sentences.zh: 注輦、三佛齊使者至，以真珠、龍腦、金蓮花等登陛跪散之，謂之“撒殿”。

translations.literal: When envoys from Chola and Srivijaya arrived, they ascended the steps kneeling and scattered pearls, camphor, golden lotus flowers, and the like—this was called "scattering the hall"—
translations.idiomatic: When envoys from Chola and Srivijaya arrived, they ascended the steps kneeling and scattered pearls, camphor, golden lotuses, and the like in what was called "scattering the hall"—

sentences.zh: 元祐二年，知潁昌府韓縝言：“交 阯小國，其使人將及境，臣嚐近弼，難以抗禮。

translations.literal: In the second year of Yuanyou Han Zong, prefect of Yingchang, stated: "Jiaozhi is a small state; when its envoys are about to reach the border, I once served close to the chief ministers and find it hard to stand on equal ritual footing.
translations.idiomatic: In 1087 Han Zong, prefect of Yingchang, stated: "Jiaozhi is a small state; when its envoys approach the border, I who once served among the chief ministers find it difficult to stand on equal ceremonial footing.

sentences.zh: 按元豐中迓以兵官，餞以通判，使副詣府，其犒設令兵官主之。

translations.literal: According to Yuanfeng practice, welcoming was by military officials, parting feasts by deputy prefects; envoy and deputy came to the prefecture; their entertainment and gifts were supervised by military officials—
translations.idiomatic: Under Yuanfeng practice military officials welcomed them and deputy prefects hosted parting feasts; the envoy and deputy came to the prefecture, and entertainment was overseen by military officials—

sentences.zh: 請如故事。

translations.literal: I request that precedent be followed—
translations.idiomatic: I ask that precedent be followed—

sentences.zh: ”仍詔所過郡，凡前宰相、執政官知判者 亦如之。

translations.literal: " Moreover an edict ordered that for every commandery they passed through, wherever a former chief minister or executive official served as prefect and judge, the same applied—
translations.idiomatic: An edict also ordered that in every commandery they passed, wherever a former chief minister or executive served as prefect, the same rule applied—

sentences.zh: 又詔立回賜於闐國信分物法。

translations.literal: Also an edict established regulations for return gifts and distribution of articles for Khotan state missions—
translations.idiomatic: An edict also established regulations for return gifts and distribution of articles to Khotan missions—

sentences.zh: 歲遣貢使雖多，止一加賜。

translations.literal: Though tribute envoys were sent many times each year, additional grants were made only once—
translations.idiomatic: Though Khotan sent tribute envoys many times a year, additional grants were made only once—

sentences.zh: 又命於闐國使以表章至，則間歲聽一入貢，餘令於熙、秦州貿易。

translations.literal: Also it was ordered that when Khotan envoys arrived with memorials, they were permitted to present tribute once every other year; the rest were ordered to trade at Xi and Qin Prefectures—
translations.idiomatic: Khotan envoys arriving with memorials were permitted to present tribute once every other year; others were to trade at Xi and Qin—

sentences.zh: 禮部言：“元豐著 令，西南五姓蕃，每五年許一貢。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites stated: "In the Yuanfeng compiled regulations, the five southwestern surname tribes were permitted tribute once every five years.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites stated: "Under Yuanfeng regulations the five southwestern surname tribes were permitted tribute once every five years.

sentences.zh: 今西南蕃泰平軍入貢，期限未及。

translations.literal: Now a southwestern tribe of Taiping Army is presenting tribute, but the term has not yet arrived—
translations.idiomatic: Now a southwestern tribe of Taiping Army is presenting tribute before the term has arrived—

sentences.zh: ”詔特許之。

translations.literal: " An edict specially permitted it—
translations.idiomatic: An edict specially permitted it—

sentences.zh: 學士院言：“諸蕃初入貢者，請令安撫、鈐轄、轉運等司體問其國所在遠近大小， 與見今入貢何國為比，保明聞奏，庶待遇之禮不致失當。

translations.literal: The Academy of Academicians stated: "For various tribes first presenting tribute, it is requested that pacification, military control, transport, and other offices inquire in detail of the state's location, distance, and size, with which currently tributary state it should be compared, certify and report, so that the rites of reception may not be inappropriate.
translations.idiomatic: The Hanlin Academy stated: "For tribes first presenting tribute, pacification, military control, transport, and other offices should inquire into the state's location, distance, and size, identify which current tributary state it resembles, certify and report, so reception rites may be appropriate.

sentences.zh: ”宣和詔蕃國入貢，令本路驗實保明。

translations.literal: " In Xuanhe an edict ordered that when barbarian states presented tribute, the route in question should verify and certify—
translations.idiomatic: In Xuanhe an edict ordered that tributary states' missions be verified and certified by the route in question—

sentences.zh: 如涉詐偽，以上書詐不實論。

translations.literal: If fraud was involved, they were prosecuted under the statute on memorializing falsely—
translations.idiomatic: Fraud was prosecuted under the statute on false memorials—

sentences.zh: 建炎三年，占城國王遣使進貢，適遇大禮，遂加恩，特授檢校少傅，加食邑。

translations.literal: In the third year of Jianyan the king of Champa dispatched envoys to present tribute; it happened to coincide with a major ceremony, so favor was added—he was specially appointed Acting Junior Mentor and granted added fief income—
translations.idiomatic: In 1129 the king of Champa sent tribute envoys; the mission coincided with a major ceremony, so he was specially appointed Acting Junior Mentor with added fief income—

sentences.zh: 自後明堂郊祀，並仿此。

translations.literal: Thereafter at Bright Hall suburban sacrifices all followed this—
translations.idiomatic: Thereafter Bright Hall suburban sacrifices followed this precedent—

sentences.zh: 紹興二年，占城國王遣使貢沉香、犀、象、玳瑁等，答以綾錦銀絹。

translations.literal: In the second year of Shaoxing the king of Champa dispatched envoys presenting agarwood, rhinoceros horn, ivory, tortoise shell, and the like; the response was with damask, brocade, silver, and silk—
translations.idiomatic: In 1132 the king of Champa sent agarwood, rhinoceros horn, ivory, tortoise shell, and the like; the court responded with damask, brocade, silver, and silk—

sentences.zh: 建炎四年，南平王薨，差廣南西路轉運副使尹東句充吊祭使，賜絹布各五百匹，羊、酒、寓錢、寓彩、寓金銀等，就欽州授其國迎接人，製贈侍中，進封南越王。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Jianyan the Prince of Nanping died; Vice Transport Commissioner of the Guangnan West Circuit Yin Dongju was appointed mourning and condolence envoy; five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth were granted, goats, wine, substitute money, substitute colored goods, substitute gold and silver, and the like, and at Qinzhou were delivered to men sent to receive them from that state; posthumously bestowed was the title of Palace Attendant and advanced enfeoffment as King of Southern Yue—
translations.idiomatic: In 1130 the Prince of Nanping died; Yin Dongju, vice transport commissioner of Guangnan West Circuit, was appointed condolence envoy with five hundred bolts each of silk and cloth, goats, wine, substitute money, goods, and gold and silver; at Qinzhou these were handed to his state's reception party; he was posthumously made Palace Attendant and advanced to King of Southern Yue—

sentences.zh: 封其子為交阯郡王，遇大禮，並加恩如占城國王。

translations.literal: His son was enfeoffed as Prince of Jiaozhi Commandery; when major ceremonies occurred, favor was added the same as for the king of Champa—
translations.idiomatic: His son was enfeoffed Prince of Jiaozhi; at major ceremonies he received the same favors as the king of Champa—

sentences.zh: 淳熙元年，賜“安南國王”印，銅鑄，塗以金。

translations.literal: In the first year of Chunxi the seal reading "King of Annan" was granted, cast in copper and gilded—
translations.idiomatic: In 1174 the court granted a seal reading "King of Annan," cast in copper and gilded—

sentences.zh: 紹興七年，三佛齊國乞進章奏赴闕朝見，詔許之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Shaoxing the state of Srivijaya requested permission to present a memorial and come to court for audience; an edict permitted it—
translations.idiomatic: In 1137 Srivijaya requested leave to present a memorial and come to court; the court permitted it—

sentences.zh: 令廣東經略司斟量，隻許四十人到闕，進貢南珠、象齒、龍涎、珊瑚、琉璃、香藥。

translations.literal: The Guangdong frontier commissioner was ordered to deliberate; only forty persons were permitted to reach the capital; they presented southern pearls, ivory, ambergris, coral, glass, and aromatic medicines—
translations.idiomatic: The Guangdong frontier commissioner was to deliberate; only forty persons might reach the capital, presenting southern pearls, ivory, ambergris, coral, glass, and aromatic medicines—

sentences.zh: 詔補保順慕化大將軍、三佛 齊國王，給賜鞍馬、衣帶、銀器。

translations.literal: An edict appointed him Bao-shun, General Who Cherishes Transformation, King of Srivijaya, and granted saddle horses, robes, belts, and silver vessels—
translations.idiomatic: He was appointed General Who Cherishes Transformation and King of Srivijaya, and granted saddle horses, robes, belts, and silver vessels—

sentences.zh: 賜使人宴於懷遠驛。

translations.literal: The envoys were granted a banquet at the Cherish-the-Distant relay station—
translations.idiomatic: The envoys were banqueted at the Cherish-the-Distant station—

sentences.zh: 淳熙五年，再入貢。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Chunxi they presented tribute again—
translations.idiomatic: In 1178 they presented tribute again—

sentences.zh: 計其直二萬五千緡，回賜綾錦羅絹等物、銀二千五百兩。

translations.literal: Calculating the value at twenty-five thousand strings of cash, the return gifts were damask, brocade, gauze, silk, and the like, and two thousand five hundred taels of silver—
translations.idiomatic: Their tribute was valued at twenty-five thousand strings of cash; return gifts were damask, brocade, gauze, silk, and two thousand five hundred taels of silver—
